## 0. Ground rules for this plan

- Every task is TDD: write the test, run it RED (and confirm it is red for
  the stated reason), implement, run it GREEN, commit. One commit per task
  unless the task says otherwise. A case marked (PIN) is a regression pin
  already green on unchanged code; every task still has at least one real
  RED case.
- Commits: a separate bare `git status` read first, check
  `W:\AI Projects\Housing Choice\HC Application\.git\worktrees\property-requirements\MERGE_HEAD`
  is absent, explicit paths only (never `git add -A`), ASCII message ending
  with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`
  (or the authoring model's name).
- Every new/touched line in code, comments, tests, copy and docs is ASCII.
  Check: `tr -d '\11\12\15\40-\176' < FILE | wc -c` prints 0 for new files;
  for a pre-existing file with non-ASCII (`unitFields.ts`, `unitsRepo.ts`,
  `units.ts` and several dashboard files carry em dashes and arrows), only
  ADDED lines must be ASCII: `git diff -U0 -- FILE | grep '^+' | tr -d '\11\12\15\40-\176' | wc -c`
  prints 0. Do not add new em dashes; the copy in 1.1 uses ASCII hyphens.
- Never rewrite source with PowerShell `Get-Content | -replace | Set-Content`.
  Use the Edit tool. The Edit/Write tools DECODE `\u` escapes - verify any
  literal backslash-u with `grep -n '\\u'` after the edit.
- Dependencies: the planner ran `npm ci` at the worktree root on 2026-10-20
  (log `.superpowers/sdd/npm-ci.log`). Never symlink another worktree's
  node_modules.
- Run app tests from `app/` with `npx vitest run test/<file>`, dashboard
  tests from `dashboard/` with `npx vitest run src/<path>`, e2e only through
  the e2e workspace (`npm run e2e`, or `npm run e2e:session` + the
  Playwright MCP). Never pipe a test or gate command. Every app vitest run,
  even a pure file, needs DynamoDB Local (`npm run db:start` STARTS it; never
  RESTART the shared container - it wipes local data; ask the human).
  `ALLOW_SKIP_DYNAMO_TESTS=1` is allowed ONLY for a pure-file red/green
  step, never for a gate.
- Never touch the live stack (`:5174` / `:8080`).
- Never edit dashboard/app source while this worktree's e2e suite runs (it
  serves the source live).
- Line numbers in this plan are hints against main @1d7a4667; the QUOTED
  text is the anchor. Where an earlier task changed a region, re-read the
  current text and apply the change ON TOP of it - never revert an earlier
  task.

## 1. Global constraints (from the spec; the spec wins on any doubt)

- EIGHT requirement items (D1), in this order, with these groups, fields
  and flyer visibility. Item ids, unit keys and landlord keys are BINDING:

  | Group | Item id | Item label | Unit key | Kind | Field label | Flyer |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | Screening | `evictions` | Evictions | `no_evictions_on_program` | checkbox | No evictions while on the program | Staff only |
  | | | | `evictions_notes` | text | Evictions (details) | Staff only |
  | Screening | `credit_requirements` | Credit score | `credit_requirements` | text | Credit score | Staff only |
  | Screening | `income_requirements` | Income requirements | `income_requirements` | text | Income requirements | Staff only |
  | Screening | `qualifications` | Qualifications | `qualifications` | long_text | Qualifications | Staff only |
  | Pets | `pets` | Pets | `no_pets` | checkbox | No pets | On flyer |
  | | | | `pets` | text (legacy boolean read/write, D1) | Pets (details) | On flyer |
  | | | | `pet_fee` | text | Pet fee | On flyer |
  | Move-in costs | `deposit` | Deposit | `deposit_one_month` | checkbox | One month's rent | On flyer |
  | | | | `deposit` | money | Fixed amount | On flyer |
  | | | | `deposit_flexible` | checkbox | Flexible / payment terms available | On flyer |
  | | | | `deposit_notes` | text | Deposit notes | Staff only |
  | Move-in costs | `application_fee` | Application fee | `application_fee` | money (0 = No application fee) | Application fee (+ checkbox "No application fee") | On flyer |
  | Touring | `touring` | Touring | `tour_type` | tour_type | Tour type | Staff only |
  | | | | `tour_process` | text | Tour process | Staff only |

  Landlord keys are `req_` + the unit key (`req_no_evictions_on_program`
  ... `req_tour_process`, 15 keys). No boolean `req_pets`.
- Value kinds (D1): checkbox = `true` or absent (`false`/null REMOVE);
  text = trimmed string ('' / null REMOVE); money = finite number >= 0 or
  null (REMOVE); `tour_type` unchanged (`self_guided` / `landlord_led` /
  `pm_team`, '' / null REMOVE). Deposit: a resulting record holding BOTH
  `deposit_one_month` and `deposit` is a 400 `{ error: 'deposit_conflict' }`
  (checked against a CONSISTENT read of the stored record whenever the body
  carries any Deposit key).
- Legacy unit `pets` boolean (D1): READ `false` = No pets checked + details
  blank; `true` = No pets unchecked + details "Allowed". WRITE of a boolean
  stores the new shape at once (`false` -> `no_pets: true` + `pets` REMOVEd;
  `true` -> `no_pets` REMOVEd + `pets: 'Allowed'`). A write touching some
  Pets keys on a unit whose STORED `pets` is a boolean also stores `no_pets`
  and `pets` in the new shape with their interpreted values. Free text is
  never parsed.
- Item equality (D1): every key of the item equal after interpretation;
  absent / '' / `false` all blank; text trimmed, case-sensitive; numbers
  exact.
- `requirement_sources` (D5): a plain map `{ <item id>: 'copied' | 'set_here' }`
  on the unit, server-written only (never in `WRITABLE_FIELDS`), always
  written WHOLE in the same update as the item keys; an empty map REMOVEs
  the attribute; absent item = never touched.
- Classification (D5): every item whose INTERPRETED value a write changes
  is compared with "the landlord's value": equal -> `copied`, different ->
  `set_here`. The landlord's value is the snapshot (create with
  `requirements_snapshot`, all items it names), the landlord's CURRENT
  values (create without a snapshot - only items written non-blank; PATCH),
  or the Apply's landlord values (Apply: every changing item -> `copied`).
  No landlord -> every touched item `set_here`. A landlord change (PATCH
  `landlordId`, `restoreWithLandlord` onto a different landlord, the
  `addContact` landlord claim) REMOVEs the map in the same write; a PATCH
  that changes the landlord AND touches items resets first, then classifies
  against the NEW landlord. The importer's fill of an absent `landlordId`
  leaves the map alone. The landlord's own edits never touch a property.
- PATCH fence (D5): when the body touches any requirement key or changes
  `landlordId`, a consistent read of the unit + the landlord contact, then
  ONE write conditioned on the unit's `requirement_sources` and
  `landlordId` being what was read (absent included); on a condition
  failure re-read and recompute, at most 3 attempts in all, then 409
  `{ error: 'property_changed' }`.
- Tags (D6): equal -> no tag; different + `copied` -> orange "Landlord
  updated" + "Landlord now: <v>"; different + `set_here` -> purple "Set on
  this property" + "Landlord: <v>"; different + never touched + property
  not blank -> as `set_here`; property blank + never touched + landlord not
  blank -> "Landlord: <v>" only. A blank landlord value prints "blank" and
  COUNTS as differing. No landlord or a failed landlord load -> no tags, no
  lines. OWN VALUE = `set_here`, or never touched with a non-blank property
  value, whatever the landlord holds.
- Voucher sizes (D4): `voucher_size_accepted` write kind accepts null / `[]`
  (REMOVE), an integer 0..12 (stored as a one-item list), or an array of
  integers 0..12 (stored de-duplicated, ascending); anything else 400.
  `acceptedVoucherSizes` stays the ONE reader (app + dashboard mirror).
- Matching (D12): `bedroomSizes: number[]` of chip values 0..4, 4 = "4 or
  more"; legacy `bedroomSize: n` reads as `[min(n, 4)]` through ONE
  normalizer; POST accepts either (`bedroomSizes` wins); the wire returns
  `bedroomSizes` always and `bedroomSize` (the first) when non-empty.
- Nothing filters or ranks on the requirements (spec section 5). No
  backfill, no importer change, no AI prompt change.

## 2. Binding interfaces

Names, signatures and wire shapes below are BINDING across slices. A
section writer who finds one wrong against the code raises a CONTRACT ISSUE
at the top of its draft instead of silently deviating.

### 2.1 App: `app/src/lib/requirements.ts` (NEW, pure, no I/O)

```ts
export type RequirementItemId =
  | 'evictions' | 'credit_requirements' | 'income_requirements' | 'qualifications'
  | 'pets' | 'deposit' | 'application_fee' | 'touring';
export type RequirementGroup = 'Screening' | 'Pets' | 'Move-in costs' | 'Touring';
export type RequirementFieldKind = 'checkbox' | 'text' | 'long_text' | 'money' | 'tour_type';
export type FlyerVisibility = 'on_flyer' | 'staff_only';

export interface RequirementField {
  key: string;            // unit key, e.g. 'no_pets'
  landlordKey: string;    // 'req_' + key
  label: string;          // 1.0 "Field label"
  kind: RequirementFieldKind;
  flyer: FlyerVisibility;
}
export interface RequirementItem {
  id: RequirementItemId;
  label: string;
  group: RequirementGroup;
  fields: readonly RequirementField[];
}
/** D1, in display order. */
export const REQUIREMENT_ITEMS: readonly RequirementItem[];
export const REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS: readonly RequirementItemId[];
export const REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS: readonly string[];      // 15, item order then field order
export const REQUIREMENT_LANDLORD_KEYS: readonly string[];  // 15 'req_' keys, same order
export function isRequirementItemId(v: unknown): v is RequirementItemId;
export function itemOfUnitKey(key: string): RequirementItem | undefined;

/** One item's value: every key of the item -> its interpreted value; null = blank. */
export type ItemValue = Record<string, string | number | true | null>;

/** D1 read interpretation from a UNIT record (legacy pets boolean, trim, blank -> null). */
export function unitItemValue(unit: Record<string, unknown>, id: RequirementItemId): ItemValue;
/** The same from a LANDLORD contact (req_ keys; never a boolean pets). Keys of the
 *  returned value are the UNIT keys, so unit and landlord values compare directly. */
export function landlordItemValue(contact: Record<string, unknown>, id: RequirementItemId): ItemValue;
export function itemValuesEqual(a: ItemValue, b: ItemValue): boolean;
export function isItemBlank(v: ItemValue): boolean;

/** D1 kinds, shared by the unit validator and the landlord validator.
 *  ok.value: the value to store, or null = REMOVE. */
export function normalizeRequirementValue(
  field: RequirementField, value: unknown, keyForError: string,
): { ok: true; value: string | number | true | null } | { ok: false; error: string };
/** D2: pick the req_ keys out of a contacts PATCH body (unknown req_ keys ignored, like
 *  every unknown contact key). fields maps req_ key -> value or null (REMOVE). */
export function parseLandlordRequirementPatch(
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
): { ok: true; fields: Record<string, string | number | true | null> } | { ok: false; error: string };
/** D1: true when the record (unit keys, or req_ keys with side 'landlord') holds both a
 *  one-month deposit and a fixed amount. */
export function hasDepositConflict(record: Record<string, unknown>, side: 'unit' | 'landlord'): boolean;

export type RequirementSource = 'copied' | 'set_here';
export type RequirementSources = Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, RequirementSource>>;
/** Defensive read of the stored map: non-object -> {}; unknown ids / values dropped. */
export function readRequirementSources(raw: unknown): RequirementSources;
/** D6 OWN VALUE. */
export function isOwnValue(sources: RequirementSources, id: RequirementItemId, unitValue: ItemValue): boolean;

/** D5 create snapshot, as parsed from the wire (2.4). */
export interface RequirementsSnapshot {
  landlordId: string;
  items: Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, ItemValue>>;   // keys = unit keys; missing key = blank
}
export function parseRequirementsSnapshot(
  raw: unknown,
): { ok: true; snapshot: RequirementsSnapshot } | { ok: false; error: string };

/** D5 classification - the ONE rule for create and PATCH.
 *  changed = items whose interpreted value differs between `before` and `after`;
 *  classified = changed, plus (create with a snapshot) every item the snapshot names.
 *  Target per classified item: the snapshot's item when named, else
 *  landlordItemValue(landlord, id); no landlord -> 'set_here'.
 *  Returns the WHOLE next map: `current` with the classified items overwritten. */
export function nextRequirementSources(input: {
  before: Record<string, unknown>;          // {} on create
  after: Record<string, unknown>;           // the unit as it will be stored
  current: RequirementSources;              // {} on create or after a landlord-change reset
  landlord: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  snapshot?: RequirementsSnapshot;          // create only
}): RequirementSources;

/** D8 per-unit Apply decision (pure). `landlordValues` = landlordItemValue for every listed
 *  item (already checked equal to `expected` by the route). */
export type ApplySkipReason =
  | 'not_found' | 'deleted' | 'landlord_changed'
  | 'changed_since_opened' | 'already_matches' | 'changed_during_apply';
export function planUnitApply(input: {
  unit: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;    // consistent read; undefined = not found
  landlordId: string;
  items: readonly RequirementItemId[];
  landlordValues: Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, ItemValue>>;
  ownItems: readonly RequirementItemId[];
}):
  | { kind: 'skip'; reason: Exclude<ApplySkipReason, 'changed_during_apply'> }
  | { kind: 'write'; patch: Record<string, unknown>;  // unit keys -> value or null, plus requirement_sources (map or null)
      changedKeys: string[]; changedItems: RequirementItemId[] };

/** D10a: every field on the New / Edit property forms, in form order. */
export interface FormFieldVisibility {
  label: string;               // the form label (1.1)
  keys: readonly string[];     // the unit key(s) the field writes
  flyer: FlyerVisibility;
}
export const PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS: readonly FormFieldVisibility[];

export const WASHER_DRYER_VALUES: readonly ['hookups', 'included', 'none'];
export const VOUCHER_SIZE_MAX: 12;
```

`planUnitApply` writes, for each CHANGING item, every key of the item to the
landlord's value (SET, or null = REMOVE for blank), so a legacy boolean
`pets` is rewritten into the new shape as part of the Pets item. Its
`requirement_sources` is `{...readRequirementSources(unit.requirement_sources), <each changing item>: 'copied'}`
(null when empty). `changedKeys` lists the unit keys whose STORED value the
write changes (for the audit), never `requirement_sources`. Check order:
not found, deleted, landlord changed, then changing items by interpreted
value; nothing changing -> `already_matches`; a changing item that is an
own value and not in `ownItems` -> `changed_since_opened`.

### 2.2 App: `app/src/lib/unitFields.ts`

- `WRITABLE_FIELDS` gains `no_evictions_on_program`, `evictions_notes`,
  `credit_requirements`, `income_requirements`, `qualifications`, `no_pets`,
  `pet_fee`, `deposit_one_month`, `deposit_flexible`, `deposit_notes`,
  `washer_dryer`; `deposit`, `application_fee`, `tour_process`, `pets`,
  `tour_type` change kind per 1.0; `subzone` becomes clearable text;
  `voucher_size_accepted` becomes the list kind (D4). Requirement keys
  validate through `normalizeRequirementValue`.
- `pets` boolean on write: the validator emits the new shape
  (`pets: false` -> `{ no_pets: true, pets: null }`; `pets: true` ->
  `{ no_pets: null, pets: 'Allowed' }`). A body carrying a boolean `pets`
  together with `no_pets` is a 400
  `pets: a boolean pets cannot be combined with no_pets`.
- `validateUnitBody` stays pure and does NOT check `deposit_conflict` (that
  needs the stored record; S2 does it in the route).
- `UnitFlyer` / `toUnitFlyer` (D11): REMOVES `subzone`; ADDS
  `voucher_sizes: number[]`, `no_pets: boolean`, `pet_fee: string | null`,
  `deposit_one_month: boolean`, `deposit_flexible: boolean`,
  `washer_dryer: 'hookups' | 'included' | 'none' | null`; KEEPS
  `voucher_size`, `deposit`, `application_fee`, `pets` (now: the details
  text per the read interpretation - a legacy `true` -> 'Allowed', a legacy
  `false` -> null with `no_pets: true`; type `string | null`). Never public:
  every Staff-only key in 1.0 and `requirement_sources`.

### 2.3 App: `app/src/repos/unitsRepo.ts`

```ts
// UnitItem gains the 1.0 keys (pets: string | boolean stays), washer_dryer,
// voucher_size_accepted?: number | number[], requirement_sources?: Record<string, 'copied' | 'set_here'>.

/** D5 PATCH fence: SET non-null / REMOVE null fields of `patch`, stamp updated_at, conditioned on
 *  attribute_exists(unitId) AND landlordId AND requirement_sources exactly as in `read`
 *  (attribute_not_exists when absent). Throws ConditionalCheckFailedException on any condition
 *  failure; the CALLER re-reads to tell a missing unit (404) from a race (retry). ALL_NEW. */
updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read: UnitItem, patch: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<UnitItem>;
/** D8: the same fence plus attribute_not_exists(deleted_at). */
applyRequirements(read: UnitItem, patch: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<UnitItem>;
```

`restoreWithLandlord` (a restore whose new landlord differs from the stored
one) and `addContact` (the landlord claim on an ownerless unit) add
`requirement_sources: null` to the patch they already write. The in-memory
harness repo (`app/test/helpers/twilioWebhookHarness.ts:2857-2925`)
implements both new methods and both REMOVEs with the same conditions.

### 2.4 App: wire

- POST `/api/units` body MAY carry `requirements_snapshot` (the route
  removes it before `validateUnitBody`): `{ landlordId: string,
  <item id>: { <unit key>: string | number | boolean | null } }`. 400
  `requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId` (not an
  object / no string `landlordId`); 400
  `requirements_snapshot.<item id> must be an object` (an item value that is
  not a plain object); 400
  `requirements_snapshot.landlordId does not match landlordId`. Unknown item
  ids and unknown keys inside an item are ignored; a missing key counts as
  blank; values are read through the item's kinds (a value that fails its
  kind counts as blank - trusted, not verified, D5). Create also answers
  400 `deposit_conflict` when the created record would hold both.
- PATCH `/api/units/:unitId`: as today, plus 400 `deposit_conflict`, 409
  `property_changed`, and `requirement_sources` maintained per D5.
- Every unit response carries `requirement_sources` as stored (absent when
  never written).
- Audit `unit_updated` `fields` = the unit keys the write SETs or REMOVEs
  (body keys after normalization plus keys the server added - the pets
  partner, a cleared deposit amount), never `requirement_sources`. On the
  plain path (no requirement key, no landlord change) it stays today's
  `Object.keys(validation.fields)`.
- PATCH `/api/contacts/:contactId`: accepts the 15 `req_` keys per
  `parseLandlordRequirementPatch`; any present `req_` key on a contact whose
  RESULTING type is not `landlord` -> 400
  `requirements can only be set on a landlord`; 400 `deposit_conflict`
  against a consistent read of the stored contact merged with the body;
  audit `contact_updated` lists the changed `req_` keys with the other
  changed fields. A `req_pets` write never touches `pets`, `pets_source` or
  AI suggestions. Contact CREATE ignores `req_` keys.
- POST `/api/contacts/:contactId/requirements/apply` (D8): body
  `{ units: [{ unitId: string, ownItems: string[] }], items: string[], expected: { <item id>: { <unit key>: value | null } } }`.
  Order of refusals: 404 `{ error: 'contact_not_found' }`; 400
  `{ error: <message> }` for: not a landlord (`contact is not a landlord`),
  `items` empty or naming an unknown item, `expected` not covering exactly
  the listed items and their keys, `units` empty / repeating a unit / over
  100, an `ownItems` entry not in `items`; 409
  `{ error: 'deposit_conflict' }` when the landlord holds both; 409
  `{ error: 'requirements_changed' }` when any listed item's CURRENT
  landlord value is not equal (D1) to `expected`. Then per unit in order:
  consistent read, `planUnitApply`, `unitsRepo.applyRequirements`; a
  `ConditionalCheckFailedException` -> skip `changed_during_apply`. Each
  written unit: audit `unit_updated` `{ actor, fields: changedKeys, reason: 'requirements_applied', landlordId }`.
  200 `{ updated: string[], skipped: Array<{ unitId: string, reason: ApplySkipReason }> }`.
- `toUnitActivityEvent` (`units.ts:311-376`) lifts `reason` for
  `unit_updated` ONLY when it is exactly `'requirements_applied'`.

### 2.5 App: Matching (`blastAudienceRules.ts`, `broadcastsRepo.ts`, `broadcasts.ts`, `audienceResolution.ts`)

```ts
// broadcastsRepo.ts AudienceFilter:
//   bedroomSizes?: number[];          // D12: chip values 0..4, 4 = 4 or more; stored by new drafts
//   /** @deprecated legacy stored shape; read ONLY through bedroomSizesOfFilter */
//   bedroomSize?: number;

// blastAudienceRules.ts
export const VOUCHER_CHIP_MAX = 4;
/** D12 - the ONLY reader of a filter's voucher sizes: bedroomSizes when it is an array
 *  (finite integers kept, each min(n, 4), de-duplicated, ascending), else a finite
 *  legacy bedroomSize as [min(n, 4)], else []. */
export function bedroomSizesOfFilter(
  filter: { bedroomSizes?: unknown; bedroomSize?: unknown } | undefined,
): number[];
/** D12 match: empty sizes -> true; else tenant size defined and (size in sizes when
 *  size < 4, or 4 in sizes when size >= 4). */
export function voucherSizeMatches(sizes: readonly number[], tenantSize: number | undefined): boolean;
// WireAudienceFilter: bedroomSizes: number[] (always), bedroomSize?: number (first, when non-empty)
```

POST `/api/broadcasts` `audience_filter`: `bedroomSizes` = an array of
integers 0..12 (400 `audience_filter.bedroomSizes must be an array of integers 0..12`),
`bedroomSize` as today; both present -> `bedroomSizes` wins; stored as
`bedroomSizes` (normalized; omitted when empty), never `bedroomSize`. The
resolver uses `voucherSizeMatches(bedroomSizesOfFilter(filter), voucherSizeOf(contact))`
and logs `bedroomSizesFilter` (the list) in place of `bedroomSizeFilter`.

## 3. Slices, task numbering, order

Order S1 -> S7, strictly sequential. Each slice ends green on its own unit
suites and `npm run typecheck`. The e2e suite is NOT expected green until
S7. Stated mid-build breakage (nothing to fix before S7 unless a slice says
so):

- From S1: a stored voucher size becomes a list on every save, so the
  property page's "Voucher size accepted" row (number-only) goes blank and
  `e2e/scenarios/steps.ts` voucher assertions fail until S6/S7; the flyer
  stops showing subzone; '' on `tour_process` / `pets` now REMOVEs; plus
  the four items of AR4.
- From S2: the unit create/PATCH responses carry `requirement_sources`.
- From S4 (app part) to S4 (dashboard part): the server stores
  `bedroomSizes`; dashboard reads `bedroomSize` from the wire's compat key.
- S5 changes form labels (`Pets` -> `Pets (details)`, `Deposit` ->
  `Fixed amount`, `Voucher size accepted` -> `Voucher sizes accepted`, ...),
  so e2e selectors against them fail until S7.

Slices:

- **S1 - App foundations** (Tasks 1.x): the registry module 2.1 (items,
  kinds, interpretation, equality, sources read, own value, snapshot parse,
  `nextRequirementSources`, `planUnitApply`, `PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS`, the
  landlord patch parser, deposit conflict); the unit validator 2.2;
  `UnitItem` / `ContactItem` types; `toUnitFlyer` 2.2 + the D10a parity
  walk; the stale comments (`unitsRepo.ts:443-446`, the flyer never-list).
- **S2 - App property writes** (Tasks 2.x): repo 2.3 (both fenced methods,
  the two landlord-change REMOVEs) + the harness repo + the real/fake
  parity test; POST create (snapshot, classification, `deposit_conflict`);
  PATCH (read path, legacy pets partner, `deposit_conflict`, landlord
  change reset, classification, fence + retry + 409, audit fields);
  `toUnitActivityEvent`.
- **S3 - App landlord and Apply** (Tasks 3.x): contacts PATCH `req_` keys;
  the Apply route; the full-profile seed (one demo landlord with
  requirements; its properties with one copied, one set-here and one
  landlord-updated item; the `[2, 3]` unit stays); lean byte-stable.
- **S4 - Matching, app and dashboard** (Tasks 4.x): 2.5 server side, the
  matrix seed (one legacy `bedroomSize`, one `bedroomSizes`); dashboard
  types, `AudienceFilters` multi-select, `BroadcastComposer` pre-fill (one
  chip per accepted size, 4+ mapping, tags, note), `broadcastFormat`
  summary, `useComposerDraft` draft key, `BroadcastsList` /
  `BroadcastResults`.
- **S5 - Dashboard property forms** (Tasks 5.x): types + endpoints (2.6),
  the dashboard registry mirror + D10a parity, `FlyerTag` / `FlyerLegend`,
  `VoucherSizePicker`, `RequirementsFields`, `ListingEditForm` (order, tags,
  legend, picker, subzone, washer/dryer, requirements, No application fee,
  One month's rent, the 409 message), `UnitCreateForm` (the same fields +
  landlord prefill, snapshot, refill, load / failure states).
- **S6 - Dashboard pages** (Tasks 6.x): `requirementDisplay` /
  `formatItemValue`; `PropertyRequirementsCard` + `ListingDetail` (rows
  moved and added) + `useListing` (re-read the landlord on a `landlordId`
  change); `listingFormat` (sizes formatting, Activity label);
  `FlyerPage` + `publicApi` (D11); `LandlordRequirementsCard` +
  `ContactEditForm` fieldset + the Notes copy; `ApplyRequirementsDialog` +
  `LandlordFile` / `ContactDetail` wiring + `useContactFile` refetch and the
  page taking the dialog's contact.
- **S7 - e2e, docs, completion** (Tasks 7.x): repair every e2e spec and
  step that asserts an old shape (spec section 7 list, plus the label
  sweep below); the two `getByLabel('Notes')` selectors `{ exact: true }`;
  the new e2e spec (spec section 6 "E2E"); GLOSSARY, the mermaid line, the
  issue registry (close two issues, partly close `unit-onboarding-fields`);
  the single main sync, THEN the five gates (AR44); the handback.

- Playwright `getByLabel('X')` is a case-insensitive SUBSTRING match: new
  labels `No pets`, `Pets (details)`, `Pet fee`, `Deposit notes`,
  `Fixed amount`, `Application fee` / `No application fee`,
  `Evictions (details)`, `Tour type`, `Tour process` collide with existing

  sweeps every `getByLabel` in `e2e/` against the property and landlord
  forms; S5 checks testing-library `getByLabelText` (exact by default, but
  regex selectors such as `ListingEditForm.test.tsx:178-200` `/Application fee/i`
  match both).
- Tags never enter a field's accessible name (D10): the tag sits outside
  the `<label>` ELEMENT (the forms use wrapping labels,
  `ListingEditForm.tsx:464-472`), tied by `aria-describedby`.
- The registry and its dashboard mirror carry the SAME test cases (the
  `acceptedVoucherSizes` pattern).
- `primaryHandoffParity.integration.test.ts` and the other
  `restoreWithLandlord` suites must stay green; the harness repo's new
  behavior is pinned against the real repo where a parity suite exists.

Each section writer raised CONTRACT ISSUES at the top of its draft (kept
below as written). Rulings, in slice order. Where a ruling amends sections
0-3, the amendment is stated here and section 4 wins.

S1 (app foundations)

  gains `{ label: 'Owning landlord', keys: ['landlordId'], flyer: 'staff_only' }`
  as its FIRST row, in the app module (S1 Task 1.7 adds it, and the D10a walk's
  sample unit gains a `landlordId`) and in the mirror (S5 Task 5.2 already has
  it). The New form tags its landlord picker Staff only; Edit-form tests skip
  that row (the Edit form has no landlord field). The 35-row list in S5 Task
  5.2 is the binding content; S1 Task 1.7's list must equal it row for row
  (the S5 parity test imports the app module and compares).

  `['application_fee']`, On flyer) just before `Application fee`. ACCEPT.

  BINDING (S3's tests and S5 assert them): checkbox `<key> must be true, false or null`;
  text / long_text `<key> must be a string or null`; money `<key> must be a number`
  / `<key> must be >= 0`; tour_type `<key> must be one of: self_guided, landlord_led, pm_team`;

  `washer_dryer must be one of: hookups, included, none`. `<key>` is the unit

2.1: the types, `REQUIREMENT_ITEMS` and its flattened ids / keys,
`isRequirementItemId`, `itemOfUnitKey`, `ItemValue`, `unitItemValue`,
`landlordItemValue`, `itemValuesEqual`, `isItemBlank`,
`normalizeRequirementValue`, `parseLandlordRequirementPatch`,
`hasDepositConflict`, `WASHER_DRYER_VALUES`, `VOUCHER_SIZE_MAX`. Delivers
D1 (items, groups, labels, keys, kinds, flyer visibility, the value kinds,
the legacy pets READ, item equality, "One month's rent" vs an amount as
alternatives), D2 (the `req_` keys; no boolean `req_pets`), D3 / D4

### Step 1 - tests (write first)

`app/test/requirements.test.ts` (precedent for a pure lib suite:
`app/test/unitFields.test.ts:1-14`):

```ts
// Unit tests for the requirement registry (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-property-requirements-design.md D1, D2):
// the eight items, their keys and kinds, the D1 read interpretation (incl. the
// legacy pets boolean), item equality, the deposit conflict and the landlord
// PATCH parser. Pure - no I/O. The dashboard mirror's suite
// (dashboard/src/routes/listing/requirements.test.ts, slice S5) carries the
// SAME cases - keep them in step.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS,
  REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS,
  REQUIREMENT_LANDLORD_KEYS,
  REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS,
  VOUCHER_SIZE_MAX,
  WASHER_DRYER_VALUES,
  hasDepositConflict,
  isItemBlank,
  isRequirementItemId,
  itemOfUnitKey,
  itemValuesEqual,
  landlordItemValue,
  normalizeRequirementValue,
  parseLandlordRequirementPatch,
  unitItemValue,
  type ItemValue,
  type RequirementField,
} from '../src/lib/requirements.js';

/** The registry field behind a unit key (throws on a typo, so no case passes vacuously). */
function fieldOf(key: string): RequirementField {
  const field = itemOfUnitKey(key)?.fields.find((f) => f.key === key);
  if (field === undefined) throw new Error(`no requirement field ${key}`);
  return field;
}

/** A hand-built item value holding what ItemValue's type forbids (false, '', untrimmed text). */
function raw(value: Record<string, unknown>): ItemValue {
  return value as ItemValue;
}

const UNIT_KEYS = [
  'no_evictions_on_program',
  'evictions_notes',
  'credit_requirements',
  'income_requirements',
  'qualifications',
  'no_pets',
  'pets',
  'pet_fee',
  'deposit_one_month',
  'deposit',
  'deposit_flexible',
  'deposit_notes',
  'application_fee',
  'tour_type',
  'tour_process',
];

describe('REQUIREMENT_ITEMS - the eight items (D1)', () => {

      ['income_requirements', 'Income requirements', 'Screening'],
      ['qualifications', 'Qualifications', 'Screening'],

    ]);
    expect(REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS).toEqual(REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.map((item) => item.id));
  });

      ['qualifications', 'qualifications', 'req_qualifications', 'Qualifications', 'long_text', 'staff_only'],

      ['pets', 'pets', 'req_pets', 'Pets (details)', 'text', 'on_flyer'],
      ['pets', 'pet_fee', 'req_pet_fee', 'Pet fee', 'text', 'on_flyer'],
      ['deposit', 'deposit_one_month', 'req_deposit_one_month', "One month's rent", 'checkbox', 'on_flyer'],
      ['deposit', 'deposit', 'req_deposit', 'Fixed amount', 'money', 'on_flyer'],
      ['deposit', 'deposit_flexible', 'req_deposit_flexible', 'Flexible / payment terms available', 'checkbox', 'on_flyer'],
      ['deposit', 'deposit_notes', 'req_deposit_notes', 'Deposit notes', 'text', 'staff_only'],
      ['application_fee', 'application_fee', 'req_application_fee', 'Application fee', 'money', 'on_flyer'],

describe('normalizeRequirementValue - the D1 write kinds', () => {
  it('checkbox: true stores true; false and null REMOVE (null); anything else is an error', () => {
    const f = fieldOf('no_pets');
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, true, 'no_pets')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: true });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, false, 'no_pets')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, null, 'no_pets')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    for (const bad of ['true', 1, 0, '', {}]) {
      expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, bad, 'no_pets')).toEqual({
        ok: false,
        error: 'no_pets must be true, false or null',
      });
    }
  });

  it('text: trimmed and case kept; blank and null REMOVE; a non-string is an error', () => {
    const f = fieldOf('pet_fee');
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, '  $300 one-time  ', 'pet_fee')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: '$300 one-time' });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, 'Cats OK', 'pet_fee')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 'Cats OK' });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, '', 'pet_fee')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, '   ', 'pet_fee')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, null, 'pet_fee')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    for (const bad of [300, true, false, [], {}]) {
      expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, bad, 'pet_fee')).toEqual({
        ok: false,
        error: 'pet_fee must be a string or null',
      });
    }
  });

  it('long_text follows the text rules and keeps inner newlines', () => {
    const f = fieldOf('qualifications');
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, '\nBackground check\nNo prior landlord debt\n', 'qualifications')).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      value: 'Background check\nNo prior landlord debt',
    });
  });

  it('money: a finite number >= 0 stores (0 included); null REMOVEs; else an error', () => {
    const f = fieldOf('deposit');
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, 1400, 'deposit')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 1400 });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, 0, 'deposit')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 0 });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, 1400.5, 'deposit')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 1400.5 });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, null, 'deposit')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, -1, 'deposit')).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'deposit must be >= 0' });
    for (const bad of ['1400', '', Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, true, {}]) {
      expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, bad, 'deposit')).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'deposit must be a number' });
    }
  });

  it('tour_type: a TourType stores; "" and null REMOVE; anything else is an error', () => {
    const f = fieldOf('tour_type');
    for (const t of ['self_guided', 'landlord_led', 'pm_team']) {
      expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, t, 'tour_type')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: t });
    }
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, '', 'tour_type')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, null, 'tour_type')).toEqual({ ok: true, value: null });
    for (const bad of ['concierge', 'SELF_GUIDED', ' pm_team', 42, true, {}]) {
      expect(normalizeRequirementValue(f, bad, 'tour_type')).toEqual({
        ok: false,
        error: 'tour_type must be one of: self_guided, landlord_led, pm_team',
      });
    }
  });

  it('names keyForError in the message (the landlord side passes the req_ key)', () => {
    expect(normalizeRequirementValue(fieldOf('deposit'), 'x', 'req_deposit')).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      error: 'req_deposit must be a number',
    });
  });
});

describe('unitItemValue / landlordItemValue - the D1 read', () => {
  it('returns every key of the item: blank as null, text trimmed', () => {
    expect(unitItemValue({}, 'deposit')).toEqual({
      deposit_one_month: null,
      deposit: null,
      deposit_flexible: null,
      deposit_notes: null,
    });
    expect(
      unitItemValue({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit_flexible: false, deposit_notes: '  split in two  ' }, 'deposit'),
    ).toEqual({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit: null, deposit_flexible: null, deposit_notes: 'split in two' });
    expect(unitItemValue({ tour_type: 'pm_team', tour_process: '' }, 'touring')).toEqual({
      tour_type: 'pm_team',
      tour_process: null,
    });
  });

  it('reads a stored value that fails its kind as blank', () => {
    expect(unitItemValue({ tour_type: 'concierge' }, 'touring')['tour_type']).toBeNull();
    expect(unitItemValue({ deposit: '1400' }, 'deposit')['deposit']).toBeNull();
    expect(unitItemValue({ deposit: -5 }, 'deposit')['deposit']).toBeNull();
    expect(unitItemValue({ no_evictions_on_program: 'yes' }, 'evictions')['no_evictions_on_program']).toBeNull();
    expect(unitItemValue({ credit_requirements: 650 }, 'credit_requirements')['credit_requirements']).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a legacy pets false = No pets checked, details blank (the fee reads as stored)', () => {
    expect(unitItemValue({ pets: false, pet_fee: '$300' }, 'pets')).toEqual({ no_pets: true, pets: null, pet_fee: '$300' });
  });

  it('a legacy pets true = No pets unchecked, details "Allowed"', () => {
    expect(unitItemValue({ pets: true }, 'pets')).toEqual({ no_pets: null, pets: 'Allowed', pet_fee: null });
  });

  it('the legacy boolean decides BOTH keys, even beside a stray stored no_pets', () => {
    expect(unitItemValue({ pets: true, no_pets: true }, 'pets')).toEqual({ no_pets: null, pets: 'Allowed', pet_fee: null });
  });

  it('free text is never parsed: "No pets" stays details text', () => {
    expect(unitItemValue({ pets: 'No pets' }, 'pets')).toEqual({ no_pets: null, pets: 'No pets', pet_fee: null });
  });

  it('landlordItemValue reads the req_ keys and returns UNIT keys (the tenant pets / no_pets are ignored)', () => {
    expect(landlordItemValue({ req_no_pets: true, req_pet_fee: '$300', pets: 'tenant answer', no_pets: true }, 'pets')).toEqual({
      no_pets: true,
      pets: null,
      pet_fee: '$300',
    });
  });

  it('landlordItemValue never interprets a boolean req_pets (the landlord side has none)', () => {
    expect(landlordItemValue({ req_pets: false }, 'pets')).toEqual({ no_pets: null, pets: null, pet_fee: null });
    expect(landlordItemValue({ req_pets: true }, 'pets')).toEqual({ no_pets: null, pets: null, pet_fee: null });
  });
});

describe('itemValuesEqual / isItemBlank - D1 equality', () => {
  it('absent, null, "" and false are all blank', () => {
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ pets: null }), raw({}))).toBe(true);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ pets: '' }), raw({ pets: null }))).toBe(true);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ no_pets: false }), raw({}))).toBe(true);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ pets: '   ' }), raw({ pets: null }))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('text compares after trimming, case-sensitive', () => {
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ pets: ' Cats OK ' }), raw({ pets: 'Cats OK' }))).toBe(true);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ pets: 'cats ok' }), raw({ pets: 'Cats OK' }))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('numbers compare exactly; 0 is a value, never blank; a number never equals its text', () => {
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ deposit: 1400 }), raw({ deposit: 1400 }))).toBe(true);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ deposit: 1400 }), raw({ deposit: 1400.01 }))).toBe(false);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ application_fee: 0 }), raw({ application_fee: null }))).toBe(false);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(raw({ pet_fee: 300 }), raw({ pet_fee: '300' }))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('a multi-field item (Deposit) is equal only when every key is equal', () => {
    const unit = unitItemValue({ deposit_one_month: true }, 'deposit');
    expect(itemValuesEqual(unit, landlordItemValue({ req_deposit_one_month: true }, 'deposit'))).toBe(true);
    expect(
      itemValuesEqual(unit, landlordItemValue({ req_deposit_one_month: true, req_deposit_flexible: true }, 'deposit')),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      itemValuesEqual(
        unitItemValue({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit_notes: 'Half up front' }, 'deposit'),
        landlordItemValue({ req_deposit_one_month: true }, 'deposit'),
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('legacy pets compare by meaning; free text "No pets" is NOT the No pets checkbox', () => {
    expect(itemValuesEqual(unitItemValue({ pets: false }, 'pets'), landlordItemValue({ req_no_pets: true }, 'pets'))).toBe(true);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(unitItemValue({ pets: true }, 'pets'), landlordItemValue({ req_pets: 'Allowed' }, 'pets'))).toBe(true);
    expect(itemValuesEqual(unitItemValue({ pets: 'No pets' }, 'pets'), landlordItemValue({ req_no_pets: true }, 'pets'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('unit and landlord values compare directly (same keys)', () => {
    expect(
      itemValuesEqual(
        unitItemValue({ tour_type: 'self_guided', tour_process: 'Lockbox' }, 'touring'),
        landlordItemValue({ req_tour_type: 'self_guided', req_tour_process: ' Lockbox ' }, 'touring'),
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it('isItemBlank: every key blank', () => {
    expect(isItemBlank(unitItemValue({}, 'pets'))).toBe(true);
    expect(isItemBlank(unitItemValue({ tour_process: '   ' }, 'touring'))).toBe(true);
    expect(isItemBlank(unitItemValue({ application_fee: 0 }, 'application_fee'))).toBe(false);
    // A legacy false MEANS No pets checked - not blank.
    expect(isItemBlank(unitItemValue({ pets: false }, 'pets'))).toBe(false);
    expect(isItemBlank(raw({ no_pets: false, pets: '' }))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('hasDepositConflict - "One month\'s rent" and a fixed amount are alternatives (D1)', () => {
  it('unit side: true only when the record holds BOTH', () => {
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 1400 }, 'unit')).toBe(true);
    // A fixed amount of 0 is still an amount.
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 0 }, 'unit')).toBe(true);
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit_one_month: true }, 'unit')).toBe(false);
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit: 1400 }, 'unit')).toBe(false);
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit_one_month: false, deposit: 1400 }, 'unit')).toBe(false);
    // A merged patch's null (REMOVE) counts as absent, so a caller may merge
    // the validated fields over the stored record directly.
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit: null }, 'unit')).toBe(false);
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit_one_month: null, deposit: 1400 }, 'unit')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('landlord side reads the req_ keys only', () => {
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ req_deposit_one_month: true, req_deposit: 1400 }, 'landlord')).toBe(true);
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 1400 }, 'landlord')).toBe(false);
    expect(hasDepositConflict({ req_deposit_one_month: true, req_deposit: 1400 }, 'unit')).toBe(false);
  });
});

      req_no_pets: true,

      req_tour_process: 'Text Ana',
    };
    const res = parseLandlordRequirementPatch(body);
    expect(res.ok && Object.keys(res.fields)).toEqual(REQUIREMENT_LANDLORD_KEYS);
  });

  });

  it('skips an undefined value (not a REMOVE)', () => {

  });

  it('never accepts a boolean req_pets', () => {
    for (const bad of [true, false]) {
      expect(parseLandlordRequirementPatch({ req_pets: bad })).toEqual({

        error: 'req_pets must be a string or null',

    }
  });

  it('names the req_ key in every error', () => {
    expect(parseLandlordRequirementPatch({ req_application_fee: -5 })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      error: 'req_application_fee must be >= 0',
    });
    expect(parseLandlordRequirementPatch({ req_tour_type: 'concierge' })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      error: 'req_tour_type must be one of: self_guided, landlord_led, pm_team',
    });
    expect(parseLandlordRequirementPatch({ req_no_pets: 'yes' })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      error: 'req_no_pets must be true, false or null',
    });
  });
});
```

Every case fails: the suite cannot load because

### Step 3 - implementation

Create `app/src/lib/requirements.ts`:

```ts
// Landlord requirements and property fields: THE requirement registry and its
// pure rules (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-property-requirements-design.md,
// tracker #11 + #12).
//
// ONE module defines the eight requirement ITEMS (D1) - id, label, group, the
// unit key of each field, its kind and its flyer visibility - shared by
// validation (lib/unitFields.ts, the contacts PATCH), copying (Apply, D8),
// comparing (where each value came from, D5) and the dashboard. An item is the
// unit of copying, comparing and tagging: a checkbox or choice and the free
// text that details it are ONE item (Cameron, 2026-10-20).
//
// Pure: no I/O and no repo imports. Vocabulary: a `unit` in code is a
// "property" in staff copy (documentation/GLOSSARY.md).
//
// Hand-mirrored in dashboard/src/routes/listing/requirements.ts (no
// cross-workspace import exists - the acceptedVoucherSizes pattern). This copy
// is the source of truth, and both suites carry the same cases.
import { isTourType } from './toursModel.js';

export type RequirementItemId =
  | 'evictions'
  | 'credit_requirements'
  | 'income_requirements'
  | 'qualifications'
  | 'pets'
  | 'deposit'
  | 'application_fee'
  | 'touring';
export type RequirementGroup = 'Screening' | 'Pets' | 'Move-in costs' | 'Touring';
export type RequirementFieldKind = 'checkbox' | 'text' | 'long_text' | 'money' | 'tour_type';
export type FlyerVisibility = 'on_flyer' | 'staff_only';

export interface RequirementField {
  /** The unit key, e.g. 'no_pets'. */
  key: string;
  /** The landlord contact key: 'req_' + key (D2). */
  landlordKey: string;
  /** The form label (plan 1.0 "Field label"). */
  label: string;
  kind: RequirementFieldKind;
  flyer: FlyerVisibility;
}

export interface RequirementItem {
  id: RequirementItemId;
  label: string;
  group: RequirementGroup;
  fields: readonly RequirementField[];
}

function defineField(
  key: string,
  label: string,
  kind: RequirementFieldKind,
  flyer: FlyerVisibility,
): RequirementField {
  return Object.freeze({ key, landlordKey: `req_${key}`, label, kind, flyer });
}

function defineItem(
  id: RequirementItemId,
  label: string,
  group: RequirementGroup,
  fields: RequirementField[],
): RequirementItem {
  return Object.freeze({ id, label, group, fields: Object.freeze(fields) });
}

/** D1, in display order (the order and grouping every surface shows). */
export const REQUIREMENT_ITEMS: readonly RequirementItem[] = Object.freeze([
  defineItem('evictions', 'Evictions', 'Screening', [
    defineField('no_evictions_on_program', 'No evictions while on the program', 'checkbox', 'staff_only'),
    defineField('evictions_notes', 'Evictions (details)', 'text', 'staff_only'),
  ]),
  defineItem('credit_requirements', 'Credit score', 'Screening', [
    defineField('credit_requirements', 'Credit score', 'text', 'staff_only'),
  ]),
  defineItem('income_requirements', 'Income requirements', 'Screening', [
    defineField('income_requirements', 'Income requirements', 'text', 'staff_only'),
  ]),
  defineItem('qualifications', 'Qualifications', 'Screening', [
    defineField('qualifications', 'Qualifications', 'long_text', 'staff_only'),
  ]),
  defineItem('pets', 'Pets', 'Pets', [
    defineField('no_pets', 'No pets', 'checkbox', 'on_flyer'),
    // The EXISTING unit key. A legacy bare boolean is read (and, on the unit
    // write only, accepted) per D1 - see unitItemValue below.
    defineField('pets', 'Pets (details)', 'text', 'on_flyer'),
    defineField('pet_fee', 'Pet fee', 'text', 'on_flyer'),
  ]),
  defineItem('deposit', 'Deposit', 'Move-in costs', [
    // "One month's rent" and a fixed amount are ALTERNATIVES (hasDepositConflict).
    defineField('deposit_one_month', "One month's rent", 'checkbox', 'on_flyer'),
    defineField('deposit', 'Fixed amount', 'money', 'on_flyer'),
    defineField('deposit_flexible', 'Flexible / payment terms available', 'checkbox', 'on_flyer'),
    defineField('deposit_notes', 'Deposit notes', 'text', 'staff_only'),
  ]),
  defineItem('application_fee', 'Application fee', 'Move-in costs', [
    // 0 = "No application fee"; absent = no fee recorded.
    defineField('application_fee', 'Application fee', 'money', 'on_flyer'),
  ]),
  defineItem('touring', 'Touring', 'Touring', [
    defineField('tour_type', 'Tour type', 'tour_type', 'staff_only'),
    defineField('tour_process', 'Tour process', 'text', 'staff_only'),
  ]),
]);

export const REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS: readonly RequirementItemId[] = Object.freeze(
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.map((item) => item.id),
);
/** The 15 unit keys, item order then field order. */
export const REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.flatMap((item) => item.fields.map((field) => field.key)),
);
/** The 15 landlord keys ('req_' + the unit key), in the same order. */
export const REQUIREMENT_LANDLORD_KEYS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.flatMap((item) => item.fields.map((field) => field.landlordKey)),
);

/** D3: the recorded washer / dryer values ('' or null REMOVEs; absent = Not recorded). */
export const WASHER_DRYER_VALUES = Object.freeze(['hookups', 'included', 'none'] as const);
/** D4: the largest voucher (bedroom) size a property can record. */
export const VOUCHER_SIZE_MAX = 12;

const ITEM_BY_ID: ReadonlyMap<string, RequirementItem> = new Map(
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.map((item) => [item.id, item] as const),
);
const ITEM_BY_UNIT_KEY: ReadonlyMap<string, RequirementItem> = new Map(
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.flatMap((item) => item.fields.map((field) => [field.key, item] as const)),
);

export function isRequirementItemId(v: unknown): v is RequirementItemId {
  return typeof v === 'string' && ITEM_BY_ID.has(v);
}

/** The item a unit key belongs to; undefined for any other key. */
export function itemOfUnitKey(key: string): RequirementItem | undefined {
  return ITEM_BY_UNIT_KEY.get(key);
}

function itemById(id: RequirementItemId): RequirementItem {
  const item = ITEM_BY_ID.get(id);
  if (item === undefined) throw new Error(`requirements: unknown item id ${String(id)}`);
  return item;
}

// --- Values (D1) --------------------------------------------------------------

/** One item's value: every key of the item -> its interpreted value; null = blank. */
export type ItemValue = Record<string, string | number | true | null>;
type StoredValue = string | number | true | null;

/** D1 legacy pets: the details text a legacy `pets: true` reads as. */
const LEGACY_PETS_ALLOWED = 'Allowed';

/**
 * The D1 canonical form used by equality: absent, null, false and blank text
 * are all blank (null); text is trimmed (case kept); a finite number is itself.
 */
function canonical(v: unknown): StoredValue {
  if (v === true) return true;
  if (typeof v === 'string') {
    const trimmed = v.trim();
    return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : null;
  }
  if (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
  return null;
}

/** One STORED value read through its field's kind; a value that fails the kind reads as blank. */
function readField(field: RequirementField, raw: unknown): StoredValue {
  if (field.kind === 'checkbox') return raw === true ? true : null;
  if (field.kind === 'money') {
    return typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw) && raw >= 0 ? raw : null;
  }
  if (field.kind === 'tour_type') return isTourType(raw) ? raw : null;
  return typeof raw === 'string' ? canonical(raw) : null;
}

/**
 * D1 read interpretation of one item on a UNIT record. A legacy bare boolean
 * `pets` decides BOTH Pets keys: false = No pets checked + details blank;
 * true = No pets unchecked + details "Allowed". Free text is never parsed.
 */
export function unitItemValue(unit: Record<string, unknown>, id: RequirementItemId): ItemValue {
  const item = itemById(id);
  const value: ItemValue = {};
  for (const field of item.fields) value[field.key] = readField(field, unit[field.key]);
  const legacy = unit['pets'];
  if (id === 'pets' && typeof legacy === 'boolean') {
    value['no_pets'] = legacy ? null : true;
    value['pets'] = legacy ? LEGACY_PETS_ALLOWED : null;
  }
  return value;
}

/**
 * The same from a LANDLORD contact: reads the req_ keys (never a boolean
 * req_pets) and returns the UNIT keys, so unit and landlord values compare
 * directly.
 */
export function landlordItemValue(contact: Record<string, unknown>, id: RequirementItemId): ItemValue {
  const item = itemById(id);
  const value: ItemValue = {};
  for (const field of item.fields) value[field.key] = readField(field, contact[field.landlordKey]);
  return value;
}

/** D1 item equality: every key equal after the canonical form (a missing key is blank). */
export function itemValuesEqual(a: ItemValue, b: ItemValue): boolean {
  for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)])) {
    if (canonical(a[key]) !== canonical(b[key])) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** True when every key of the value is blank. */
export function isItemBlank(v: ItemValue): boolean {
  return Object.values(v).every((x) => canonical(x) === null);
}

/**
 * D1 write kinds, shared by the unit validator and the landlord parser.
 * ok.value is the value to store, or null = REMOVE. Callers skip `undefined`.
 */
export function normalizeRequirementValue(
  field: RequirementField,
  value: unknown,
  keyForError: string,
): { ok: true; value: string | number | true | null } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  if (field.kind === 'checkbox') {
    if (value === true) return { ok: true, value: true };
    if (value === false || value === null) return { ok: true, value: null };
    return { ok: false, error: `${keyForError} must be true, false or null` };
  }
  if (field.kind === 'money') {
    if (value === null) return { ok: true, value: null };
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `${keyForError} must be a number` };
    }
    if (value < 0) return { ok: false, error: `${keyForError} must be >= 0` };
    return { ok: true, value };
  }
  if (field.kind === 'tour_type') {
    if (value === '' || value === null) return { ok: true, value: null };
    if (!isTourType(value)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `${keyForError} must be one of: self_guided, landlord_led, pm_team` };
    }
    return { ok: true, value };
  }
  // text / long_text
  if (value === null) return { ok: true, value: null };
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return { ok: false, error: `${keyForError} must be a string or null` };
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return { ok: true, value: trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : null };
}

/**
 * D2: pick the req_ keys out of a contacts PATCH body. Unknown req_ keys are
 * ignored, like every unknown contact key; an undefined value is skipped.
 * fields maps req_ key -> value, or null (REMOVE).
 */
export function parseLandlordRequirementPatch(
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
): { ok: true; fields: Record<string, string | number | true | null> } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  const fields: Record<string, string | number | true | null> = {};
  for (const item of REQUIREMENT_ITEMS) {
    for (const field of item.fields) {
      if (!Object.hasOwn(body, field.landlordKey)) continue;
      const raw = body[field.landlordKey];
      if (raw === undefined) continue;
      const result = normalizeRequirementValue(field, raw, field.landlordKey);
      if (!result.ok) return result;
      fields[field.landlordKey] = result.value;
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, fields };
}

/**
 * D1: true when the record (unit keys, or req_ keys with side 'landlord')
 * holds both a one-month deposit and a fixed amount. null counts as absent,
 * so a caller may merge validated fields (null = REMOVE) over the stored record.
 */
export function hasDepositConflict(record: Record<string, unknown>, side: 'unit' | 'landlord'): boolean {
  const prefix = side === 'landlord' ? 'req_' : '';
  const amount = record[`${prefix}deposit`];
  return (
    record[`${prefix}deposit_one_month`] === true && typeof amount === 'number' && Number.isFinite(amount)
  );
}
```

```ts
// Unit tests for where each requirement value came from (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-property-requirements-design.md D5, D6):
// the stored requirement_sources map read, the OWN VALUE definition, the
// create snapshot parser and nextRequirementSources - the ONE classification
// rule create and PATCH share. Pure. The routes that call these (S2) assert
// the same rules over HTTP; the dashboard mirror (S5) carries these cases.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS,
  isOwnValue,
  landlordItemValue,
  nextRequirementSources,
  parseRequirementsSnapshot,
  readRequirementSources,
  unitItemValue,
  type RequirementItemId,
  type RequirementSources,
  type RequirementsSnapshot,
} from '../src/lib/requirements.js';

/** The landlord the New form pre-filled from (req_ keys, as stored on the contact). */
const LANDLORD: Record<string, unknown> = {
  contactId: 'contact-ll-1',
  type: 'landlord',
  req_no_pets: true,
  req_pet_fee: '$300',
  req_deposit_one_month: true,
  req_deposit_flexible: true,
  req_application_fee: 50,
  req_tour_type: 'self_guided',
  req_tour_process: 'Lockbox on the porch',
};

/** What the New form sends as requirements_snapshot, parsed (every item it names). */
function snapshotOf(
  landlord: Record<string, unknown>,
  ids: readonly RequirementItemId[] = REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS,
): RequirementsSnapshot {
  const items: RequirementsSnapshot['items'] = {};
  for (const id of ids) items[id] = landlordItemValue(landlord, id);
  return { landlordId: 'contact-ll-1', items };
}

/** The create body after the form pre-filled LANDLORD and staff changed nothing. */
const PREFILLED: Record<string, unknown> = {
  landlordId: 'contact-ll-1',
  beds: 2,
  no_pets: true,
  pet_fee: '$300',
  deposit_one_month: true,
  deposit_flexible: true,
  application_fee: 50,
  tour_type: 'self_guided',
  tour_process: 'Lockbox on the porch',
};

const ALL_COPIED: RequirementSources = Object.fromEntries(REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS.map((id) => [id, 'copied']));

describe('readRequirementSources - defensive read of the stored map (D5)', () => {
  it('reads a non-object as the empty map', () => {
    for (const bad of [undefined, null, 'copied', 42, true, [], ['pets']]) {
      expect(readRequirementSources(bad), String(bad)).toEqual({});
    }
  });

  it('keeps known item ids with known values; drops unknown ids and values', () => {
    expect(
      readRequirementSources({
        pets: 'copied',
        deposit: 'set_here',
        touring: 'manual',
        evictions: true,
        bogus: 'copied',
        no_pets: 'set_here',
      }),
    ).toEqual({ pets: 'copied', deposit: 'set_here' });
  });

  it('never reads an inherited property', () => {
    expect(readRequirementSources(Object.create({ pets: 'copied' }))).toEqual({});
  });
});

describe('isOwnValue - the D6 OWN VALUE definition', () => {
  const catsOk = unitItemValue({ pets: 'Cats OK' }, 'pets');
  const blank = unitItemValue({}, 'pets');

  it('set_here is an own value, even when the property value is blank', () => {
    expect(isOwnValue({ pets: 'set_here' }, 'pets', catsOk)).toBe(true);
    expect(isOwnValue({ pets: 'set_here' }, 'pets', blank)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('copied is never an own value', () => {
    expect(isOwnValue({ pets: 'copied' }, 'pets', catsOk)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('never touched: an own value exactly when the property value is not blank', () => {
    expect(isOwnValue({}, 'pets', catsOk)).toBe(true);
    expect(isOwnValue({}, 'pets', blank)).toBe(false);
    // A legacy false MEANS No pets - not blank, so an own value.
    expect(isOwnValue({}, 'pets', unitItemValue({ pets: false }, 'pets'))).toBe(true);
    // Another item's record does not count.
    expect(isOwnValue({ deposit: 'copied' }, 'pets', catsOk)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('parseRequirementsSnapshot - the create snapshot (D5, plan 2.4)', () => {
  it('refuses a snapshot that is not an object with a non-empty string landlordId', () => {
    for (const bad of [undefined, null, 'contact-ll-1', 42, [], {}, { landlordId: 7 }, { landlordId: '' }]) {
      expect(parseRequirementsSnapshot(bad), JSON.stringify(bad) ?? 'undefined').toEqual({
        ok: false,
        error: 'requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId',
      });
    }
  });

  it('refuses an item value that is not a plain object', () => {
    for (const bad of [null, 'No pets', [], 42, true]) {
      expect(parseRequirementsSnapshot({ landlordId: 'contact-ll-1', pets: bad })).toEqual({
        ok: false,
        error: 'requirements_snapshot.pets must be an object',
      });
    }
  });

  it('reads the named items through their kinds: a missing or failing key is blank; unknown ids and keys are ignored', () => {
    expect(
      parseRequirementsSnapshot({
        landlordId: 'contact-ll-1',
        pets: { no_pets: true, pet_fee: ' $300 ', extra: 'ignored' },
        deposit: { deposit: 'abc', deposit_flexible: true },
        touring: { tour_type: 'concierge', tour_process: 'Call' },
        bogus_item: { anything: 1 },
      }),
    ).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      snapshot: {
        landlordId: 'contact-ll-1',
        items: {
          pets: { no_pets: true, pets: null, pet_fee: '$300' },
          deposit: { deposit_one_month: null, deposit: null, deposit_flexible: true, deposit_notes: null },
          touring: { tour_type: null, tour_process: 'Call' },
        },
      },
    });
  });

  it('a boolean pets in a snapshot is blank (the landlord side never holds one)', () => {
    const res = parseRequirementsSnapshot({ landlordId: 'contact-ll-1', pets: { pets: false } });
    expect(res.ok && res.snapshot.items.pets).toEqual({ no_pets: null, pets: null, pet_fee: null });
  });

  it('an all-blank landlord snapshot parses to eight all-blank items', () => {
    const wire: Record<string, unknown> = { landlordId: 'contact-ll-1' };
    for (const id of REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS) wire[id] = {};
    const res = parseRequirementsSnapshot(wire);
    expect(res.ok && Object.keys(res.snapshot.items)).toEqual([...REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS]);
    expect(res.ok && Object.values(res.snapshot.items).every((v) => Object.values(v).every((x) => x === null))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('a snapshot naming no item has no items', () => {
    expect(parseRequirementsSnapshot({ landlordId: 'contact-ll-1' })).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      snapshot: { landlordId: 'contact-ll-1', items: {} },
    });
  });
});

describe('nextRequirementSources - create (D5)', () => {
  it('with a snapshot and the values left as pre-filled: all eight items copied', () => {
    expect(
      nextRequirementSources({ before: {}, after: PREFILLED, current: {}, landlord: LANDLORD, snapshot: snapshotOf(LANDLORD) }),
    ).toEqual(ALL_COPIED);
  });

  it('still all copied when the landlord changed after the snapshot (the target is the snapshot)', () => {
    const changed = { ...LANDLORD, req_pet_fee: '$500', req_application_fee: 75, req_credit_requirements: '650+' };
    expect(
      nextRequirementSources({ before: {}, after: PREFILLED, current: {}, landlord: changed, snapshot: snapshotOf(LANDLORD) }),
    ).toEqual(ALL_COPIED);
  });

  it('a pre-filled value staff cleared is set_here', () => {
    const { pet_fee: _cleared, ...after } = PREFILLED;
    expect(
      nextRequirementSources({ before: {}, after, current: {}, landlord: LANDLORD, snapshot: snapshotOf(LANDLORD) }),
    ).toEqual({ ...ALL_COPIED, pets: 'set_here' });
  });

  it('a pre-filled value staff changed is set_here', () => {
    expect(
      nextRequirementSources({
        before: {},
        after: { ...PREFILLED, application_fee: 0 },
        current: {},
        landlord: LANDLORD,
        snapshot: snapshotOf(LANDLORD),
      }),
    ).toEqual({ ...ALL_COPIED, application_fee: 'set_here' });
  });

  it('an item the snapshot does not name is classified as if there were no snapshot', () => {
    const named = REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS.filter(
      (id) => id !== 'qualifications' && id !== 'credit_requirements' && id !== 'touring',
    );
    expect(
      nextRequirementSources({

      }),
    ).toEqual({
      evictions: 'copied',
      income_requirements: 'copied',
      pets: 'copied',
      deposit: 'copied',
      application_fee: 'copied',
      // written, and the landlord has none -> set_here
      qualifications: 'set_here',
      // written, equal to the landlord's CURRENT value -> copied
      touring: 'copied',

    });

  it('without a snapshot: only items written non-blank, against the CURRENT landlord', () => {
    expect(
      nextRequirementSources({
        before: {},
        after: { landlordId: 'contact-ll-1', beds: 2, no_pets: true, pet_fee: '$300', application_fee: 0, tour_process: 'Call me' },
        current: {},

      }),
    ).toEqual({ pets: 'copied', application_fee: 'set_here', touring: 'set_here' });
  });

  it('with no landlord: every classified item is set_here', () => {
    expect(nextRequirementSources({ before: {}, after: { no_pets: true }, current: {}, landlord: undefined })).toEqual({
      pets: 'set_here',
    });
  });
});
```

### Step 3 - implementation

Append to the END of `app/src/lib/requirements.ts`:

```ts
// --- Where each value came from (D5) and own values (D6) ------------------------

export type RequirementSource = 'copied' | 'set_here';
export type RequirementSources = Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, RequirementSource>>;

function isPlainObject(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
}

/** Defensive read of the stored `requirement_sources` map: non-object -> {}; unknown ids / values dropped. */
export function readRequirementSources(raw: unknown): RequirementSources {
  const sources: RequirementSources = {};
  if (!isPlainObject(raw)) return sources;
  for (const id of REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(raw, id)) continue;
    const source = raw[id];
    if (source === 'copied' || source === 'set_here') sources[id] = source;
  }
  return sources;
}

/**
 * D6 OWN VALUE: the item's record is `set_here`, or the item was never
 * touched and the property's value is not blank - whatever the landlord holds.
 */
export function isOwnValue(sources: RequirementSources, id: RequirementItemId, unitValue: ItemValue): boolean {
  const source = sources[id];
  if (source === 'set_here') return true;
  if (source === 'copied') return false;
  return !isItemBlank(unitValue);
}

/** D5 create snapshot, as parsed from the wire (plan 2.4). */
export interface RequirementsSnapshot {
  landlordId: string;
  /** Keys are UNIT keys; a missing key is blank. */
  items: Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, ItemValue>>;
}

const SNAPSHOT_SHAPE_ERROR = 'requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId';

/**
 * D5: parse `requirements_snapshot` from a POST /api/units body. The values
 * are TRUSTED, not verified: each is read through its field's kind, and a
 * value that fails the kind counts as blank. Unknown item ids and unknown
 * keys inside an item are ignored. The landlordId match against the body's
 * landlordId is the route's check (it needs the body).
 */
export function parseRequirementsSnapshot(
  raw: unknown,
): { ok: true; snapshot: RequirementsSnapshot } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  if (!isPlainObject(raw)) return { ok: false, error: SNAPSHOT_SHAPE_ERROR };
  const landlordId = raw['landlordId'];
  if (typeof landlordId !== 'string' || landlordId.length === 0) {
    return { ok: false, error: SNAPSHOT_SHAPE_ERROR };
  }
  const items: Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, ItemValue>> = {};
  for (const item of REQUIREMENT_ITEMS) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(raw, item.id)) continue;
    const rawItem = raw[item.id];
    if (rawItem === undefined) continue;
    if (!isPlainObject(rawItem)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `requirements_snapshot.${item.id} must be an object` };
    }
    const value: ItemValue = {};
    for (const field of item.fields) {
      const rawValue = rawItem[field.key];
      const read = rawValue === undefined ? undefined : normalizeRequirementValue(field, rawValue, field.key);
      value[field.key] = read !== undefined && read.ok ? read.value : null;
    }
    items[item.id] = value;
  }
  return { ok: true, snapshot: { landlordId, items } };
}

/**
 * D5 classification - the ONE rule for create and PATCH.
 * changed = items whose interpreted value differs between `before` and
 * `after` (null in `after` reads as blank, so a caller may pass the stored
 * record merged with the validated fields); classified = changed, plus
 * (create with a snapshot) every item the snapshot names. Target per
 * classified item: the snapshot's item when named, else
 * landlordItemValue(landlord, id); no landlord -> 'set_here'. Equal ->
 * 'copied', different -> 'set_here'. Returns the WHOLE next map: `current`
 * with the classified items overwritten (pass {} on create and after a
 * landlord-change reset).
 */
export function nextRequirementSources(input: {
  before: Record<string, unknown>;
  after: Record<string, unknown>;
  current: RequirementSources;
  landlord: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  snapshot?: RequirementsSnapshot;
}): RequirementSources {
  const next: RequirementSources = { ...input.current };
  for (const item of REQUIREMENT_ITEMS) {
    const after = unitItemValue(input.after, item.id);
    const changed = !itemValuesEqual(unitItemValue(input.before, item.id), after);
    const fromSnapshot = input.snapshot?.items[item.id];
    if (!changed && fromSnapshot === undefined) continue;
    const target =
      fromSnapshot ?? (input.landlord === undefined ? undefined : landlordItemValue(input.landlord, item.id));
    next[item.id] = target !== undefined && itemValuesEqual(after, target) ? 'copied' : 'set_here';
  }
  return next;
}
```

## Task 1.3 - The per-unit Apply decision (planUnitApply)

Goal: append `ApplySkipReason` and `planUnitApply` (plan 2.1) - the pure
decision the S3 Apply route makes per unit. Delivers D8's per-unit rules:
check order (not found, deleted, landlord changed, then changing items by
INTERPRETED value; nothing changing -> `already_matches`; an own changing
item not in `ownItems` -> `changed_since_opened`); whole-item writes (SET or
REMOVE, the pets pair normalized over a legacy boolean); the whole new
sources map (changing items -> `copied`, a listed item that already equaled
the landlord keeps its record); `changedKeys` for the D13 audit (stored
values the write changes, never `requirement_sources`); the all-blank
landlord "Clears" case.

```ts
// Unit tests for planUnitApply (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-property-requirements-design.md D8, D5,
// D6, D13): the pure per-unit decision of Apply to properties. The S3 route
// does the reads, the conditional write (changed_during_apply) and the audit;
// this suite pins the decision.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS,
  landlordItemValue,
  planUnitApply,
  type ItemValue,
  type RequirementItemId,
} from '../src/lib/requirements.js';

const LANDLORD_ID = 'contact-ll-1';

/** The landlord's requirements as stored on the contact (req_ keys). */
const LANDLORD: Record<string, unknown> = {
  contactId: LANDLORD_ID,
  type: 'landlord',
  req_credit_requirements: '600+',
  req_no_pets: true,
  req_pet_fee: '$300',
  req_tour_type: 'landlord_led',
  req_tour_process: 'Text Ana a day ahead',
};

/** A landlord with no requirement recorded at all. */
const BLANK_LANDLORD: Record<string, unknown> = { contactId: LANDLORD_ID, type: 'landlord' };

function valuesOf(
  landlord: Record<string, unknown>,
  ids: readonly RequirementItemId[],
): Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, ItemValue>> {
  const out: Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, ItemValue>> = {};
  for (const id of ids) out[id] = landlordItemValue(landlord, id);
  return out;
}

function unit(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { unitId: 'unit-1', landlordId: LANDLORD_ID, status: 'available', ...overrides };
}

function plan(
  u: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  items: readonly RequirementItemId[],
  ownItems: readonly RequirementItemId[] = [],
  landlord: Record<string, unknown> = LANDLORD,
) {
  return planUnitApply({ unit: u, landlordId: LANDLORD_ID, items, landlordValues: valuesOf(landlord, items), ownItems });
}

describe('planUnitApply - skips, in check order (D8)', () => {
  it('not_found when the consistent read found nothing', () => {

    expect(plan(unit({ deleted_at: '2026-10-19T12:00:00.000Z', landlordId: 'contact-ll-2' }), ['pets'])).toEqual({
      kind: 'skip',

    expect(plan(unit({ landlordId: 'contact-ll-2', no_pets: true, pet_fee: '$300' }), ['pets'])).toEqual({
      kind: 'skip',
      reason: 'landlord_changed',
    });
    expect(plan({ unitId: 'unit-1', status: 'available' }, ['pets'])).toEqual({ kind: 'skip', reason: 'landlord_changed' });

    expect(

    expect(plan(unit({ pets: false }), ['pets'], [], landlord)).toEqual({ kind: 'skip', reason: 'already_matches' });
```

```ts
// --- Apply to properties: the per-unit decision (D8) ---------------------------

export type ApplySkipReason =
  | 'not_found'
  | 'deleted'
  | 'landlord_changed'
  | 'changed_since_opened'
  | 'already_matches'
  | 'changed_during_apply';

/** True when writing `next` (null = REMOVE) changes the STORED value of `key`. */
function storedValueChanges(unit: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, next: StoredValue): boolean {
  const stored = Object.hasOwn(unit, key) ? unit[key] : undefined;
  if (next === null) return stored !== undefined;
  return stored !== next;
}

/**
 * D8 per-unit Apply decision (pure). `landlordValues` = landlordItemValue for
 * every listed item (the route already checked them equal to `expected`).
 * Check order: not found, deleted, landlord changed, then the changing items
 * by INTERPRETED value (D1); nothing changing -> already_matches; a changing
 * item that is an own value (D6) and not in `ownItems` -> changed_since_opened.
 * A write sets EVERY key of each changing item to the landlord's value (null =
 * REMOVE), so a legacy boolean `pets` is rewritten into the new shape with the
 * Pets item; `requirement_sources` is the stored map (read defensively) with
 * each changing item 'copied' - a listed item that already equaled the
 * landlord keeps its record. `changedKeys` lists the unit keys whose STORED
 * value the write changes (the D13 audit), never `requirement_sources`. The
 * route's conditional write turns a race into changed_during_apply.
 */
export function planUnitApply(input: {
  unit: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  landlordId: string;
  items: readonly RequirementItemId[];
  landlordValues: Partial<Record<RequirementItemId, ItemValue>>;
  ownItems: readonly RequirementItemId[];
}):
  | { kind: 'skip'; reason: Exclude<ApplySkipReason, 'changed_during_apply'> }
  | { kind: 'write'; patch: Record<string, unknown>; changedKeys: string[]; changedItems: RequirementItemId[] } {
  const { unit } = input;
  if (unit === undefined) return { kind: 'skip', reason: 'not_found' };
  const deletedAt = unit['deleted_at'];
  if (typeof deletedAt === 'string' && deletedAt.length > 0) return { kind: 'skip', reason: 'deleted' };
  if (unit['landlordId'] !== input.landlordId) return { kind: 'skip', reason: 'landlord_changed' };

  const listed = new Set<RequirementItemId>(input.items);
  const changing: Array<{ item: RequirementItem; target: ItemValue }> = [];
  for (const item of REQUIREMENT_ITEMS) {
    if (!listed.has(item.id)) continue;
    const target = input.landlordValues[item.id];
    if (target === undefined) throw new Error(`planUnitApply: no landlord value for item ${item.id}`);
    if (!itemValuesEqual(unitItemValue(unit, item.id), target)) changing.push({ item, target });
  }
  if (changing.length === 0) return { kind: 'skip', reason: 'already_matches' };

  const sources = readRequirementSources(unit['requirement_sources']);
  const own = new Set<RequirementItemId>(input.ownItems);
  for (const { item } of changing) {
    if (isOwnValue(sources, item.id, unitItemValue(unit, item.id)) && !own.has(item.id)) {
      return { kind: 'skip', reason: 'changed_since_opened' };
    }
  }

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const changedKeys: string[] = [];
  const nextSources: RequirementSources = { ...sources };
  for (const { item, target } of changing) {
    for (const field of item.fields) {
      const next = canonical(target[field.key]);
      patch[field.key] = next;
      if (storedValueChanges(unit, field.key, next)) changedKeys.push(field.key);
    }
    nextSources[item.id] = 'copied';
  }
  patch['requirement_sources'] = Object.keys(nextSources).length > 0 ? nextSources : null;
  return { kind: 'write', patch, changedKeys, changedItems: changing.map(({ item }) => item.id) };
}
```

```ts
// Type pins for the requirement keys on the stored items (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-property-requirements-design.md D2-D5).
// The real check is `npm run typecheck` (app/tsconfig.test.json covers
// app/test): every requirement key must be a DECLARED property of UnitItem /
// ContactItem - not just the `[key: string]: unknown` index signature - with
// its stored kind. The runtime assertions keep the declared lists complete
// against the registry.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { REQUIREMENT_LANDLORD_KEYS, REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS } from '../src/lib/requirements.js';
import type { ContactItem } from '../src/repos/contactsRepo.js';
import type { UnitItem } from '../src/repos/unitsRepo.js';

/** The DECLARED keys of T (drops the index signature's string / number keys). */
type DeclaredKeys<T> = keyof {
  [K in keyof T as string extends K ? never : number extends K ? never : K]: T[K];
};

const UNIT_REQUIREMENT_KEYS: readonly DeclaredKeys<UnitItem>[] = [
  'no_evictions_on_program',
  'evictions_notes',
  'credit_requirements',
  'income_requirements',
  'qualifications',
  'no_pets',
  'pets',
  'pet_fee',
  'deposit_one_month',
  'deposit',
  'deposit_flexible',
  'deposit_notes',
  'application_fee',
  'tour_type',
  'tour_process',
];

const CONTACT_REQUIREMENT_KEYS: readonly DeclaredKeys<ContactItem>[] = [
  'req_no_evictions_on_program',
  'req_evictions_notes',
  'req_credit_requirements',
  'req_income_requirements',
  'req_qualifications',
  'req_no_pets',
  'req_pets',
  'req_pet_fee',

    const boolPets: Partial<ContactItem> = {

      req_pets: false,
    };
    expect([washer, checkbox, source, tourType, amount, boolPets]).toHaveLength(6);
  });
});
```

```
function isStringArray(v: unknown): v is string[] {
```
