Replace with:
```
function isStringArray(v: unknown): v is string[] {
  return Array.isArray(v) && v.every((s) => typeof s === 'string');
}

/** D4: one voucher size a property can record - an integer 0..VOUCHER_SIZE_MAX. */
function isVoucherSize(v: unknown): v is number {
  return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v <= VOUCHER_SIZE_MAX;
}

/** D3: a recorded washer / dryer value. */
function isWasherDryer(v: unknown): v is (typeof WASHER_DRYER_VALUES)[number] {
  return typeof v === 'string' && (WASHER_DRYER_VALUES as readonly string[]).includes(v);
}

/** The registry field behind a 'requirement' / 'pets' key (lib/requirements.ts). */
const REQUIREMENT_FIELD_BY_KEY: ReadonlyMap<string, RequirementField> = new Map(
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.flatMap((item) => item.fields.map((field) => [field.key, field] as const)),
);

function requirementField(key: string): RequirementField {
  const field = REQUIREMENT_FIELD_BY_KEY.get(key);
  if (field === undefined) throw new Error(`unitFields: ${key} is not a requirement key`);
  return field;
}
```

```
export function toUnitFlyer(unit: UnitItem): UnitFlyer {
  // The address is re-validated through the SAME write-surface validator so the
  // projection carries ONLY allowlisted sub-fields, never a legacy string blob.
  const addr = validateAddress(unit.address, 'address');
  return {
    unitId: unit.unitId,
    media: isStringArray(unit.media) ? unit.media : [],
    beds: isFiniteNumber(unit.beds) ? unit.beds : null,
    baths: isFiniteNumber(unit.baths) ? unit.baths : null,
    area: typeof unit.area === 'string' ? unit.area : null,
    subzone: typeof unit.subzone === 'string' ? unit.subzone : null,
    // The flyer states ONE size. Only the demo seed can hold a list until #12
    // adds the multi-select; that work decides how the flyer words several sizes.
    voucher_size: acceptedVoucherSizes(unit)[0] ?? null,
    accepted_authorities: authoritiesOf(unit),
    listing_link: typeof unit.listing_link === 'string' ? unit.listing_link : null,
    rent_min: isFiniteNumber(unit.rent_min) ? unit.rent_min : null,
    rent_max: isFiniteNumber(unit.rent_max) ? unit.rent_max : null,
    address: addr.ok ? addr.address : {},
    utilities: typeof unit.utilities === 'string' ? unit.utilities : null,
    video_url: typeof unit.video_url === 'string' ? unit.video_url : null,
    application_fee: isFiniteNumber(unit.application_fee) ? unit.application_fee : null,
    same_day_rta: typeof unit.same_day_rta === 'boolean' ? unit.same_day_rta : null,
    pets: typeof unit.pets === 'string' || typeof unit.pets === 'boolean' ? unit.pets : null,
    accessibility: typeof unit.accessibility === 'string' ? unit.accessibility : null,
    deposit: isFiniteNumber(unit.deposit) ? unit.deposit : null,
    lease_terms: typeof unit.lease_terms === 'string' ? unit.lease_terms : null,
  };
}
```
Replace with:
```
export function toUnitFlyer(unit: UnitItem): UnitFlyer {
  // The address is re-validated through the SAME write-surface validator so the
  // projection carries ONLY allowlisted sub-fields, never a legacy string blob.
  const addr = validateAddress(unit.address, 'address');
  // spec 2026-10-20 D11: every size, ascending and de-duplicated (a legacy
  // stored list may be neither); voucher_size keeps the first for old pages.
  const voucherSizes = [...new Set(acceptedVoucherSizes(unit))].sort((x, y) => x - y);
  // The requirement items through the D1 read interpretation (legacy pets
  // boolean, trimmed text, blank -> null). Only their ON-FLYER keys are copied.
  const pets = unitItemValue(unit, 'pets');
  const deposit = unitItemValue(unit, 'deposit');
  const fee = unitItemValue(unit, 'application_fee')['application_fee'];
  const petsDetails = pets['pets'];
  const petFee = pets['pet_fee'];
  const depositAmount = deposit['deposit'];
  return {
    unitId: unit.unitId,
    media: isStringArray(unit.media) ? unit.media : [],
    beds: isFiniteNumber(unit.beds) ? unit.beds : null,
    baths: isFiniteNumber(unit.baths) ? unit.baths : null,
    area: typeof unit.area === 'string' ? unit.area : null,
    voucher_size: voucherSizes[0] ?? null,
    voucher_sizes: voucherSizes,
    accepted_authorities: authoritiesOf(unit),
    listing_link: typeof unit.listing_link === 'string' ? unit.listing_link : null,
    rent_min: isFiniteNumber(unit.rent_min) ? unit.rent_min : null,
    rent_max: isFiniteNumber(unit.rent_max) ? unit.rent_max : null,
    address: addr.ok ? addr.address : {},
    utilities: typeof unit.utilities === 'string' ? unit.utilities : null,
    video_url: typeof unit.video_url === 'string' ? unit.video_url : null,
    application_fee: typeof fee === 'number' ? fee : null,
    same_day_rta: typeof unit.same_day_rta === 'boolean' ? unit.same_day_rta : null,
    pets: typeof petsDetails === 'string' ? petsDetails : null,
    no_pets: pets['no_pets'] === true,
    pet_fee: typeof petFee === 'string' ? petFee : null,
    accessibility: typeof unit.accessibility === 'string' ? unit.accessibility : null,
    deposit: typeof depositAmount === 'number' ? depositAmount : null,
    deposit_one_month: deposit['deposit_one_month'] === true,
    deposit_flexible: deposit['deposit_flexible'] === true,
    lease_terms: typeof unit.lease_terms === 'string' ? unit.lease_terms : null,
    washer_dryer: isWasherDryer(unit.washer_dryer) ? unit.washer_dryer : null,
  };
}
```

## Task 1.7 - PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS and the D10a parity walk

Goal: append `FormFieldVisibility` and `PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS` (plan 2.1) -
every field on the New / Edit property forms in D10 form order with its tag
- and the app-side parity walk that fails when a tag disagrees with
`toUnitFlyer`. Delivers D10 (form order, every field tagged), D10a (the
table lives in the registry; for each field, two units differing only in
that field give DIFFERENT flyers when On flyer and IDENTICAL when Staff
only), spec section 6's "the D10a parity walk over more than one base unit
(a base whose recorded sizes equal its beds would hide the voucher-size
field)". Per plan AR1 the table's FIRST row is `Owning landlord`
(`landlordId`, Staff only; New form only), 35 rows in all, and the list must
equal S5 Task 5.2's mirror row for row (S5's drift test imports this module).
CI-2 (the No application fee row) stands as drafted.

Files: `app/src/lib/requirements.ts` (append),
`app/test/propertyFormFlyerParity.test.ts` (NEW).

### Step 1 - tests (write first)

`app/test/propertyFormFlyerParity.test.ts`:

```ts
// The D10a parity walk (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-property-requirements-design.md D10,
// D10a): every field on the New / Edit property forms carries an "On flyer"
// or "Staff only" tag from PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS, and this suite FAILS when a
// tag disagrees with what the public flyer projection (toUnitFlyer)
// publishes. The dashboard mirror (slice S5) carries the same table and cases.
//
// Per field and per base unit, the walk compares the base with the field's
// keys CLEARED against the same unit with them set to a SAMPLE value - never
// the base against the field cleared: on a base whose recorded voucher sizes
// equal its beds, clearing the sizes falls back to the same sizes, which would
// make "Voucher sizes accepted" look Staff only (pinned below).
import { isDeepStrictEqual } from 'node:util';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS,
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS,
  type FlyerVisibility,
  type FormFieldVisibility,
} from '../src/lib/requirements.js';
import { acceptedVoucherSizes, toUnitFlyer, validateUnitBody } from '../src/lib/unitFields.js';
import type { UnitItem } from '../src/repos/unitsRepo.js';

/**
 * A valid, non-blank value per unit key. The walk sets it on a unit whose
 * field was CLEARED, so it only has to differ from blank and from what a
 * cleared field falls back to (no base has 7 beds or sizes 9 / 11).
 */
const SAMPLE: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> = {
  // plan AR1: the Owning landlord row. Staff only - two units differing only in
  // their landlord of record give identical toUnitFlyer output.
  landlordId: 'contact-ll-parity',
  accepted_authorities: ['Parity Housing Authority'],
  beds: 7,
  baths: 4.5,
  voucher_size_accepted: [9, 11],
  rent_min: 2222,
  rent_max: 3333,
  payment_standard: 4444,
  address: { line1: '1 Parity Way', city: 'Decatur', state: 'GA', zip: '30030' },
  subzone: 'SE11',
  washer_dryer: 'none',
  utilities: 'Parity utilities',
  accessibility: 'Parity accessibility',
  lease_terms: 'Parity lease terms',
  listing_link: 'https://example.com/parity',
  video_url: 'https://v.example/parity',
  same_day_rta: false,
  no_evictions_on_program: true,
  evictions_notes: 'Parity evictions details',
  credit_requirements: 'Parity credit',
  income_requirements: 'Parity income',
  qualifications: 'Parity qualifications',
  no_pets: true,
  pets: 'Parity pets details',
  pet_fee: 'Parity pet fee',
  deposit_one_month: true,
  deposit: 777,
  deposit_flexible: true,
  deposit_notes: 'Parity deposit notes',
  application_fee: 99,
  tour_type: 'pm_team',
  tour_process: 'Parity tour process',
  application_process: 'Parity application process',
  notes: 'Parity notes',
};

function sampleFor(key: string): unknown {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(SAMPLE, key)) throw new Error(`no parity sample for ${key} - add one`);
  return SAMPLE[key];
}

interface Base {
  name: string;
  unit: UnitItem;
}

const SIZES_EQUAL_BEDS = 'a unit whose recorded voucher sizes equal its beds';

const BASES: readonly Base[] = [
  { name: 'a bare unit', unit: { unitId: 'u-bare', landlordId: 'contact-ll-1', status: 'available' } },
  {
    name: 'a fully filled unit',
    unit: {
      unitId: 'u-full',
      landlordId: 'contact-ll-1',
      status: 'available',
      accepted_authorities: ['DCA'],
      beds: 2,
      baths: 1,
      voucher_size_accepted: [2, 3],
      rent_min: 1400,
      rent_max: 1600,
      payment_standard: 1700,
      address: { line1: '123 Base St', city: 'Atlanta', state: 'GA', zip: '30303' },
      area: 'Westside',
      subzone: 'E8',
      washer_dryer: 'hookups',
      utilities: 'Tenant pays electric',
      accessibility: 'Ground floor',
      lease_terms: '12-month minimum',
      listing_link: 'https://example.com/base',
      video_url: 'https://v.example/base',
      same_day_rta: true,
      no_evictions_on_program: true,
      evictions_notes: 'None in 5 years',
      credit_requirements: '600+',
      income_requirements: '2.5x rent',
      qualifications: 'Background check',
      pets: 'Cats OK',
      pet_fee: '$300',
      deposit: 1400,
      deposit_notes: 'Split in two',
      application_fee: 50,
      tour_type: 'self_guided',
      tour_process: 'Lockbox',
      application_process: 'Online portal',
      notes: 'Back gate sticks',
      requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' },
    },
  },
  {
    name: SIZES_EQUAL_BEDS,
    unit: {
      unitId: 'u-eq',
      landlordId: 'contact-ll-1',
      status: 'available',
      beds: 2,
      voucher_size_accepted: [2],
      no_pets: true,
      pets: 'Service animals only',
      deposit_one_month: true,
      deposit_flexible: true,
      application_fee: 0,
      washer_dryer: 'included',
      same_day_rta: false,
      tour_type: 'pm_team',
    },
  },
];

function baseNamed(name: string): UnitItem {
  const base = BASES.find((b) => b.name === name);
  if (base === undefined) throw new Error(`no base ${name}`);
  return base.unit;
}

/** Every disagreement between the table and toUnitFlyer, as "<label> | <base>: <why>". */
function flyerTagMismatches(fields: readonly FormFieldVisibility[], bases: readonly Base[]): string[] {
  const mismatches: string[] = [];
  for (const field of fields) {
    for (const base of bases) {
      const cleared: Record<string, unknown> = structuredClone(base.unit);
      for (const key of field.keys) delete cleared[key];
      const sampled: Record<string, unknown> = structuredClone(cleared);
      for (const key of field.keys) sampled[key] = sampleFor(key);
      const flyerSampled = toUnitFlyer(sampled as UnitItem);
      const changesFlyer = !isDeepStrictEqual(toUnitFlyer(cleared as UnitItem), flyerSampled);
      if (field.flyer === 'on_flyer' && !changesFlyer) {
        mismatches.push(`${field.label} | ${base.name}: tagged On flyer, but the flyer does not change`);
      }
      if (
        field.flyer === 'staff_only' &&
        (changesFlyer || !isDeepStrictEqual(toUnitFlyer(base.unit), flyerSampled))
      ) {
        mismatches.push(`${field.label} | ${base.name}: tagged Staff only, but the flyer changes`);
      }
    }
  }
  return mismatches;
}

describe('the D10a parity walk - the tags agree with toUnitFlyer', () => {
  it('(PIN) walks more than one base, one of them recording voucher sizes equal to its beds', () => {
    expect(BASES.length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    const eq = baseNamed(SIZES_EQUAL_BEDS);
    expect(acceptedVoucherSizes(eq)).toEqual([eq.beds]);
  });

  it('every On flyer field changes the flyer and every Staff only field never does, on every base', () => {
    expect(flyerTagMismatches(PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS, BASES)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('catches a wrong tag - the walk is not vacuous', () => {
    const flip = (v: FlyerVisibility): FlyerVisibility => (v === 'on_flyer' ? 'staff_only' : 'on_flyer');
    const flipped = new Set(['Subzone', 'Pets (details)', 'Deposit notes']);
    const wrong = PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS.map((f) => (flipped.has(f.label) ? { ...f, flyer: flip(f.flyer) } : f));
    const mismatches = flyerTagMismatches(wrong, BASES);
    expect(mismatches).toHaveLength(flipped.size * BASES.length);
    expect(new Set(mismatches.map((m) => m.split(' | ')[0]))).toEqual(flipped);
  });

  it('(PIN) pins the trap: on the sizes-equal-beds base, clearing the sizes alone changes nothing', () => {
    const eq = baseNamed(SIZES_EQUAL_BEDS);
    const cleared: Record<string, unknown> = structuredClone(eq);
    delete cleared['voucher_size_accepted'];
    expect(toUnitFlyer(cleared as UnitItem)).toEqual(toUnitFlyer(eq));
  });
});
```

```ts
// --- The property-form flyer tag table (D10, D10a) ------------------------------

/** D10a: one field on the New / Edit property forms and whether tenants see it on the flyer. */
export interface FormFieldVisibility {
  /** The field's form label (plan 1.1 and the forms' existing labels). */
  label: string;
  /** The unit key(s) the field writes. */
  keys: readonly string[];
  flyer: FlyerVisibility;
}

function formField(label: string, keys: readonly string[], flyer: FlyerVisibility): FormFieldVisibility {
  return Object.freeze({ label, keys: Object.freeze([...keys]), flyer });
}

/**
 * The Requirements section's fields, item then field order. "No application
 * fee" is the checkbox above the amount (D10): checked, it records 0, so it
 * writes application_fee and shares its tag.
 */
const REQUIREMENT_FORM_FIELDS: readonly FormFieldVisibility[] = REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.flatMap((item) =>
  item.fields.flatMap((field) => {
    const own = formField(field.label, [field.key], field.flyer);
    return field.key === 'application_fee'
      ? [formField('No application fee', [field.key], field.flyer), own]
      : [own];
  }),
);

/**
 * D10a: every field on the New / Edit property forms, in D10 form order
 * (the New form's landlord picker, then Property details, then Requirements,
 * then Application process and Notes), with its tag - 35 rows. The first row,
 * "Owning landlord", is on the New form only (plan AR1); the Edit form has no
 * landlord field. The app-side parity walk
 * (app/test/propertyFormFlyerParity.test.ts) fails when a tag disagrees with
 * what lib/unitFields.ts toUnitFlyer publishes; the dashboard mirror carries
 * the same table, and its drift test imports this one and compares.
 */
export const PROPERTY_FORM_FIELDS: readonly FormFieldVisibility[] = Object.freeze([
  formField('Owning landlord', ['landlordId'], 'staff_only'),
  formField('Housing authorities', ['accepted_authorities'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Beds', ['beds'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Baths', ['baths'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Voucher sizes accepted', ['voucher_size_accepted'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Rent min', ['rent_min'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Rent max', ['rent_max'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Payment standard', ['payment_standard'], 'staff_only'),
  formField('Address', ['address'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Subzone', ['subzone'], 'staff_only'),
  formField('Washer / dryer', ['washer_dryer'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Tenant-paid utilities', ['utilities'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Accessibility', ['accessibility'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Lease terms', ['lease_terms'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Public listing link', ['listing_link'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Video URL', ['video_url'], 'on_flyer'),
  formField('Same-day RTA', ['same_day_rta'], 'on_flyer'),
  ...REQUIREMENT_FORM_FIELDS,
  formField('Application process', ['application_process'], 'staff_only'),
  formField('Notes', ['notes'], 'staff_only'),
]);
```

## E. Notes for other slices

S2 (property writes):
- `validateUnitBody` output is the patch: `null` = REMOVE (create drops it).
  A boolean `pets` arrives as `{ no_pets, pets }` already. The route must
  strip `requirements_snapshot` BEFORE `validateUnitBody` (it is an unknown
  field there); `requirement_sources` stays refused (PIN in 1.5).
- `after` for `nextRequirementSources` can be `{ ...stored, ...fields }`
  directly: null reads as blank. `hasDepositConflict({ ...stored, ...fields }, 'unit')`
  likewise (null counts as absent).
- The legacy-pets PARTNER rule is the route's: when the stored `pets` is a
  boolean and the patch carries any Pets key, add the missing Pets keys from
  `unitItemValue(stored, 'pets')` (`no_pets` true or null, `pets` 'Allowed'
  or null) - S1 has no helper for it (2.1 binds none). Classification does
  not depend on it (1.2 pins both shapes); the STORED shape and the audit
  field list do.
- `parseRequirementsSnapshot` cannot see the body's `landlordId`: the
  `requirements_snapshot.landlordId does not match landlordId` 400 is the
  route's. A `requirements_snapshot: null` gets the shape 400 from the
  parser; if S2 wants null to mean "no snapshot", it must skip the parser
  for null (spec D5 says only "a malformed snapshot -> 400").
- Audit `fields` (D13) on the requirement path must be computed from what
  the write SETs / REMOVEs; S1's validator still emits both Pets keys for a
  boolean write (CI-4 b).

S3 (landlord + Apply):
- Contacts PATCH: `parseLandlordRequirementPatch(body)`; its errors name the
  `req_` key (CI-3 strings); `req_pets: true` -> `req_pets must be a string or null`.
  `hasDepositConflict(merged, 'landlord')` reads only `req_` keys.
- Apply: build `landlordValues` with `landlordItemValue(contact, id)` for
  EVERY listed item (planUnitApply throws otherwise, CI-5);
  `itemValuesEqual(landlordItemValue(contact, id), expected[id])` is the
  `requirements_changed` check. `planUnitApply(...).patch` includes
  `requirement_sources` (a map, or null when empty) and is what
  `unitsRepo.applyRequirements` writes; `changedKeys` is the audit list.
- Full seed: a `requirement_sources` value must be a plain map of item ids.

S4 (Matching): `VOUCHER_SIZE_MAX` (12) is exported from
`lib/requirements.ts` if the audience validator wants it; the chip clamp (4)

S5 (dashboard forms + mirror):

  (`getById` returns `units.get(unitId)` itself) and `:2901-2914` (`update`
  mutates that object in place). A route that passes its `getById` result
  straight to `updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, ...)` would compare the stored
  object with itself. `units.ts:2208-2212` and `:2412-2414` already document
  this hazard for media and the restore route. Proposed ruling: every caller
  of `updateIfRequirementsCurrent` / `applyRequirements` passes its OWN copy
  of the read (`structuredClone`), the fake compares the store against the
  caller's object; the S2 PATCH route does this (Task 2.5) and S3's Apply route
  must too (see Notes).
- **CI-2 "Restore with a different landlord" must include a restore that
  CLEARS the landlord.** Plan 2.3 says "a restore whose new landlord differs
  from the stored one"; `restoreWithLandlord` also takes `next: null`
  (`app/src/repos/unitsRepo.ts:207-229`, route `app/src/routes/units.ts:2444-2447`),
  which removes the landlord of record - a change under spec D5 ("Whenever a
  property's landlord of record CHANGES"). Proposed ruling: REMOVE
  `requirement_sources` whenever `(next === null ? undefined : next.contactId) !== expectLandlordId`
  (a swap or a clear; the `keepsOld` race path at `unitsRepo.ts:1656` keeps it).
- **CI-3 Audit field list - RULED (plan review round 1, PR1-10; supersedes
  this draft's first proposal).** D13 "the unit keys the write actually
  changed" wins over plan 2.4's "SETs or REMOVEs". On the FENCED path (a
  requirement key touched, or the landlord of record changed)
  `unit_updated.fields` = the keys whose STORED value the write changes - a
  SET to a value different from the read (or of a key the read lacked), or a
  REMOVE of a key the read held - computed from the read and the final patch
  (partner keys included), never `requirement_sources`. A body key re-sent
  with its stored value is NOT listed; a raw `pets: true` on a unit with no
  `no_pets` does not list `no_pets`. The PLAIN path (no requirement key, no
  landlord change - including a body re-sending the stored landlordId) keeps
  today's `Object.keys(validation.fields)` (`units.ts:2249-2252`). "A cleared
  deposit amount" (D13) is the form's own `deposit: null` body key: the server
  never clears an amount itself (it answers `deposit_conflict`). Implemented
  in Task 2.3 (`changedKeys`) and Task 2.5 (path choice).
- **CI-3b `applyRequirements` and a blank `deleted_at` - RULED (PR1-8).**
  `isDeleted` treats only a NON-EMPTY `deleted_at` as deleted
  (`unitsRepo.ts:532-534`) and S1's `planUnitApply` follows it, so the Apply
  write's not-deleted condition is
  `(attribute_not_exists(#expectedDeletedAt) OR #expectedDeletedAt = :blankDeletedAt)`
  with `:blankDeletedAt = ''`, and the fake refuses exactly when
  `isUnitDeleted(unit)`. Implemented in Task 2.1 with a parity case each way.
- **CI-4 Which landlord contact a PATCH classifies against is unspecified for
  an unusual landlord of record.** Proposed ruling: the landlord of record
  AFTER the write (the new one on a change, which must pass
  `requireLandlordContact`, `app/src/services/contactTypeGuards.ts:85-95`),
  read CONSISTENTLY; for an UNCHANGED landlordId, a missing record or a phone /
  email routing-pointer row counts as NO landlord (every changed item
  `set_here`), and any existing record (any type, soft-deleted included) is
  read for its `req_` values; an unchanged landlordId is never type-checked
  (the L2 pin `app/test/unitsLandlordOfRecord.test.ts:164-171` stays green).
- **CI-5 The PATCH landlordId check moves into the fenced loop; refusal order
  is not bound.** Today the landlordId check is one pre-read block
  (`units.ts:2179-2206`). D5 needs "does the landlord change" decided on EACH
  attempt's read, so every PATCH body naming a `landlordId` takes the fenced
  path and the block is replaced by the per-attempt decision (same 404 / 409
  bodies, same consistent read, '' still a 404 with no contact read).
  Resulting order - create: snapshot 400 -> validator 400 -> snapshot
  landlord mismatch 400 -> `deposit_conflict` 400 -> org-list 422 -> landlord
  404 / 409; PATCH: validator 400 -> tombstone no-op -> org-list 422 -> 404
  `unit_not_found` -> landlord 404 / 409 -> 400 `deposit_conflict` -> 409
  `property_changed`. Proposed ruling: accept.
- **CI-6 Residual race the D5 fence does not cover.** The fence is on
  `landlordId` + the map only. Two staff writing DIFFERENT keys of the same
  multi-key item (Evictions, Pets, Deposit, Touring) at the same instant: if
  the first write leaves the map unchanged, the second passes the fence with a
  classification computed from a read that lacks the first write's key, so
  the item's record can be stale (e.g. `set_here` where the merged value now
  equals the landlord's). D5 explicitly accepts only the landlord-values race.
  Proposed ruling: accept as the same class (the item's next write
  reclassifies it, and D6 shows an EQUAL item with no tag whatever its
  record); the alternative is fencing on every key of the touched items too,
  which changes plan 2.3's condition set.
- **CI-7 Two S2-private files not named in plan 2.x.** S2 adds
  `app/src/lib/unitRequirementWrite.ts` (the pure write planner both unit
  routes call) and `app/test/helpers/requirementsFixtures.ts` (route-test
  fixtures). Neither is a cross-slice interface. Proposed ruling: accept;
  S3 may reuse the fixtures.

### Task 2.1 - Repo: the fenced writes (`updateIfRequirementsCurrent`, `applyRequirements`)

**Goal.** Plan 2.3's two methods on the real repo and the API-test fake, with
the same conditions: write only while the unit exists and its `landlordId`
and `requirement_sources` are exactly what the caller read (absent included);
`applyRequirements` also needs the unit NOT deleted as `isDeleted` reads it
(`unitsRepo.ts:532-534`: `deleted_at` absent or '' - PR1-8). SET
non-null, REMOVE null, an EMPTY map REMOVEs, stamp `updated_at`, ALL_NEW.
Delivers D5 (the fence), D8 (the Apply write S3 calls), spec section 7 (the
harness mirrors the map write and the Apply condition).

**Files.**
- `app/src/repos/unitsRepo.ts`
- `app/test/helpers/twilioWebhookHarness.ts`
- `app/test/unitsRepoRequirementsFence.integration.test.ts` (NEW)

**Step 1 - tests (write first).** Create
`app/test/unitsRepoRequirementsFence.integration.test.ts` (the
`caseworkerRepoParity.integration.test.ts:85-178` pattern):

```ts
// property requirements (spec 2026-10-20 D5 / D8; plan 2.3): the fenced unit
// writes - unitsRepo.updateIfRequirementsCurrent (the PATCH fence) and
// unitsRepo.applyRequirements (the Apply write) - against BOTH the real repo
// (DynamoDB Local) and the API-test fake (test/helpers/twilioWebhookHarness.ts
// createFakeWorld), which the route suites run on. Each writes only while the
// unit exists with the landlordId and requirement_sources the caller READ
// (absent included); applyRequirements also refuses a soft-deleted unit - a
// NON-EMPTY deleted_at, exactly as unitsRepo.isDeleted reads it (a blank
// deleted_at is live). A lost condition throws
// ConditionalCheckFailedException and writes nothing.
// An empty map REMOVEs the attribute (it is never stored empty). The fake half
// runs without Docker; the real half self-skips.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { ConditionalCheckFailedException } from '@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb';
import { DeleteCommand, GetCommand, PutCommand } from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { tableName } from '../src/lib/config.js';
import { createDocumentClient, createDynamoClient } from '../src/lib/dynamo.js';
import { deleteTableIfExists, ensureTable } from '../src/lib/dynamoAdmin.js';
import { getTableSpec } from '../src/lib/tables.js';
import { createUnitsRepo, type UnitItem, type UnitsRepo } from '../src/repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { quietLogger } from './helpers/orgFixtures.js';
import { createFakeWorld } from './helpers/twilioWebhookHarness.js';

const endpoint = process.env.DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT ?? 'http://localhost:8000';

async function endpointReachable(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await fetch(endpoint, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1_500) });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

const reachable = await endpointReachable();
if (!reachable) {
  console.warn(
    `[unitsRepoRequirementsFence.integration] DynamoDB Local half SKIPPED - nothing at ${endpoint}. ` +
      'Run `npm run db:start` to exercise it.',
  );
}

const testEnv = { TABLE_PREFIX: `hc-test-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}-` };
const client = createDynamoClient({ endpoint });
const doc = createDocumentClient({ endpoint });
const unitsTable = tableName('units', testEnv);

beforeAll(async () => {
  if (!reachable) return;
  await ensureTable(client, getTableSpec('units'), unitsTable);
}, 120_000);

afterAll(async () => {
  if (reachable) await deleteTableIfExists(client, unitsTable);
  doc.destroy();
  client.destroy();
}, 120_000);

const STAMP = '2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z';

/** One implementation under test: the units repo plus raw seed / read / delete access. */
interface World {
  units: UnitsRepo;
  putUnit(item: UnitItem): Promise<void>;
  /** A CONSISTENT read, as the caller's OWN copy (what the fence compares against). */
  readUnit(unitId: string): Promise<UnitItem | undefined>;
  deleteUnit(unitId: string): Promise<void>;
}

function realWorld(): World {
  return {
    units: createUnitsRepo({ doc, env: testEnv, logger: quietLogger() }),
    async putUnit(item) {
      await doc.send(new PutCommand({ TableName: unitsTable, Item: item }));
    },
    async readUnit(unitId) {
      const { Item } = await doc.send(new GetCommand({ TableName: unitsTable, Key: { unitId }, ConsistentRead: true }));
      return Item as UnitItem | undefined;
    },
    async deleteUnit(unitId) {
      await doc.send(new DeleteCommand({ TableName: unitsTable, Key: { unitId } }));
    },
  };
}

function fakeWorld(): World {
  const world = createFakeWorld();
  return {
    units: world.unitsRepo,
    async putUnit(item) {
      world.units.set(item.unitId, structuredClone(item));
    },
    async readUnit(unitId) {
      const hit = world.units.get(unitId);
      return hit === undefined ? undefined : structuredClone(hit);
    },
    async deleteUnit(unitId) {
      world.units.delete(unitId);
    },
  };
}

/** One case against the harness fake (always) and DynamoDB Local (when reachable). */
function parity(name: string, run: (w: World, id: string) => Promise<void>): void {
  it(`${name} [harness fake]`, async () => {
    await run(fakeWorld(), `fake-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`);
  });
  it.skipIf(!reachable)(`${name} [DynamoDB Local]`, async () => {
    await run(realWorld(), `real-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`);
  });
}

/** A unit row owned by c-ll; a field given as undefined is left OFF (`landlordId: undefined` = ownerless). */
function unitRow(unitId: string, fields: Record<string, unknown> = {}): UnitItem {
  const row: Record<string, unknown> = {
    unitId,
    landlordId: 'c-ll',
    status: 'available',
    created_at: STAMP,
    updated_at: STAMP,
    ...fields,
  };
  for (const key of Object.keys(row)) if (row[key] === undefined) delete row[key];
  return row as UnitItem;
}

async function readBack(w: World, id: string): Promise<UnitItem> {
  const unit = await w.readUnit(id);
  if (unit === undefined) throw new Error(`unit ${id} not found`);
  return unit;
}

describe('unitsRepo.updateIfRequirementsCurrent - the PATCH fence (D5)', () => {
  parity('writes while the landlordId and the map are as read: SETs, REMOVEs, the new map whole, a fresh updated_at, ALL_NEW', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { pets: 'Cats OK', deposit: 900, requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    const written = await w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, {
      no_pets: true,
      pets: null,
      deposit: null,
      requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied', deposit: 'set_here' },
    });
    const stored = await readBack(w, id);
    expect(stored).toMatchObject({
      landlordId: 'c-ll',
      no_pets: true,
      requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied', deposit: 'set_here' },
    });
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('pets');
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('deposit');
    expect(stored.updated_at).not.toBe(STAMP);
    expect(written).toEqual(stored);
  });

  parity('writes on an ownerless unit with no map while both are still absent', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { landlordId: undefined }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, {
      credit_requirements: 'Score 600+',
      requirement_sources: { credit_requirements: 'set_here' },
    });
    const stored = await readBack(w, id);
    expect(stored).toMatchObject({
      credit_requirements: 'Score 600+',
      requirement_sources: { credit_requirements: 'set_here' },
    });
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('landlordId');
  });

  parity('an EMPTY map in the patch REMOVEs the attribute', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { requirement_sources: {} });
    expect(await readBack(w, id)).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
  });

  parity('refuses when the map changed since the read - nothing written', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied' } }));
    await expect(
      w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { pet_fee: '$300', requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConditionalCheckFailedException);
    const stored = await readBack(w, id);
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('pet_fee');
    expect(stored.requirement_sources).toEqual({ pets: 'copied' });
    expect(stored.updated_at).toBe(STAMP);
  });

  parity('refuses when the map was REMOVEd since the read - the old map is never written back', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id));
    await expect(
      w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { pet_fee: '$300', requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConditionalCheckFailedException);
    const stored = await readBack(w, id);
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('pet_fee');
  });

  parity('refuses when a map appeared since a read that had none', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { requirement_sources: { credit_requirements: 'set_here' } }));
    await expect(
      w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { income_requirements: '3x rent' }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConditionalCheckFailedException);
    expect(await readBack(w, id)).not.toHaveProperty('income_requirements');
  });

  parity('refuses when the landlordId changed since the read', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { landlordId: 'c-other' }));
    await expect(
      w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { income_requirements: '3x rent' }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConditionalCheckFailedException);
    const stored = await readBack(w, id);
    expect(stored.landlordId).toBe('c-other');
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('income_requirements');
  });

  parity('refuses when an ownerless unit was claimed since the read', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { landlordId: undefined }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { landlordId: 'c-new' }));
    await expect(
      w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { income_requirements: '3x rent' }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConditionalCheckFailedException);
    expect(await readBack(w, id)).not.toHaveProperty('income_requirements');
  });

  parity('refuses a unit that no longer exists - and never re-creates it', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.deleteUnit(id);
    await expect(
      w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { income_requirements: '3x rent' }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConditionalCheckFailedException);
    expect(await w.readUnit(id)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  parity('writes on a soft-deleted unit (only the Apply write needs a live one)', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { deleted_at: STAMP }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.units.updateIfRequirementsCurrent(read, { income_requirements: '3x rent' });
    expect((await readBack(w, id))['income_requirements']).toBe('3x rent');
  });
});

describe('unitsRepo.applyRequirements - the Apply write (D8)', () => {
  parity('applyRequirements writes a live unit whose landlordId and map are as read', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { pets: 'Cats OK', requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    const written = await w.units.applyRequirements(read, {
      no_pets: true,
      pets: null,
      requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied' },
    });
    const stored = await readBack(w, id);
    expect(stored).toMatchObject({ no_pets: true, requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied' } });
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('pets');
    expect(stored.updated_at).not.toBe(STAMP);
    expect(written).toEqual(stored);
  });

  parity('applyRequirements refuses a soft-deleted unit (a non-empty deleted_at) - nothing written', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { deleted_at: STAMP }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await expect(
      w.units.applyRequirements(read, { credit_requirements: 'Score 600+' }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConditionalCheckFailedException);
    expect(await readBack(w, id)).not.toHaveProperty('credit_requirements');
  });

  parity('applyRequirements writes a unit whose deleted_at is BLANK - live, as isDeleted reads it', async (w, id) => {
    await w.putUnit(unitRow(id, { deleted_at: '' }));
    const read = await readBack(w, id);
    await w.units.applyRequirements(read, { credit_requirements: 'Score 600+' });
    const stored = await readBack(w, id);
    expect(stored['credit_requirements']).toBe('Score 600+');
```

### Task 2.2 - A landlord-of-record change REMOVEs the map (`restoreWithLandlord`, the `addContact` claim)

**Goal.** D5: whenever a property's landlord of record changes outside a
PATCH - a restore onto a different landlord or onto none (CI-2), or a roster
claim of the vacant landlord slot - `requirement_sources` is REMOVEd in the
SAME conditional write; a roster write that keeps the landlord leaves it. The
fake mirrors it (spec section 7). Pinned at the repo level on both
implementations (the parity suite that covers these methods) - including
that a slow fenced write read BEFORE the change can never write its map back
- and on the HTTP responses of the restore and contacts-add routes.

```ts
// property requirements (spec 2026-10-20): fixtures for the unit-requirement
// route suites on the FakeWorld harness - a landlord contact holding req_
// keys, a unit row, the New form's all-blank requirements_snapshot, the
// authed unit requests, and the unit_updated audit rows.
import request from 'supertest';
import type { Express } from 'express';
import { REQUIREMENT_ITEMS, REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS } from '../../src/lib/requirements.js';
import type { ContactItem } from '../../src/repos/contactsRepo.js';
import type { UnitItem } from '../../src/repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { TEST_SESSION_COOKIE } from './authSession.js';
import { ORIGIN_SECRET, type FakeWorld } from './twilioWebhookHarness.js';

export const REQ_STAMP = '2026-10-20T09:00:00.000Z';

/** Every item 'copied': a create whose form left every pre-filled field as it was. */
export const ALL_COPIED: Record<string, 'copied'> = Object.fromEntries(
  REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS.map((id) => [id, 'copied'] as const),
);

/** A contact typed landlord holding `requirements` (req_ keys). */
export function seedLandlord(world: FakeWorld, contactId: string, requirements: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
  world.contacts.push({ contactId, type: 'landlord', firstName: 'Lee', lastName: 'Lord', ...requirements } as ContactItem);
}

/** Any other contact. */
export function seedContact(world: FakeWorld, contactId: string, fields: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  world.contacts.push({ contactId, ...fields } as ContactItem);
}

/** A unit owned by c-ll unless `fields` says otherwise; a field given as undefined is left OFF (`landlordId: undefined` = ownerless). */
export function seedUnit(world: FakeWorld, unitId: string, fields: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
  const row: Record<string, unknown> = {
    unitId,
    landlordId: 'c-ll',
    status: 'available',
    created_at: REQ_STAMP,
    updated_at: REQ_STAMP,
    ...fields,
  };
  for (const key of Object.keys(row)) if (row[key] === undefined) delete row[key];
  world.units.set(unitId, row as UnitItem);
}

/** The New form's requirements_snapshot: every item with every key null (blank), then `items` over the top. */
export function snapshotOf(
  landlordId: string,
  items: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {},
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const snapshot: Record<string, unknown> = { landlordId };
  for (const item of REQUIREMENT_ITEMS) {
    snapshot[item.id] = {
      ...Object.fromEntries(item.fields.map((field) => [field.key, null] as const)),
      ...(items[item.id] ?? {}),
    };
  }
  return snapshot;
}

export function postUnit(app: Express, body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return request(app)
    .post('/api/units')
    .set('x-origin-verify', ORIGIN_SECRET)
    .set('cookie', TEST_SESSION_COOKIE)
    .send(body);
}

export function patchUnit(app: Express, unitId: string, body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return request(app)
    .patch(`/api/units/${unitId}`)
    .set('x-origin-verify', ORIGIN_SECRET)
    .set('cookie', TEST_SESSION_COOKIE)
    .send(body);
}

export function getUnit(app: Express, unitId: string) {
  return request(app)
    .get(`/api/units/${unitId}`)
    .set('x-origin-verify', ORIGIN_SECRET)
    .set('cookie', TEST_SESSION_COOKIE);
}

/** The unit_updated audit rows, oldest first. */
export function unitUpdatedEvents(world: FakeWorld): FakeWorld['auditEvents'] {
  return world.auditEvents.filter((e) => e.event_type === 'unit_updated');
}
```

1b. Create `app/test/unitsApiRequirementsReset.test.ts`:

```ts
// property requirements (spec 2026-10-20 D5): whenever a property's landlord
// of record CHANGES outside a PATCH - a restore onto another landlord or onto
// none (POST /api/units/:id/restore), or a roster claim of the vacant landlord
// slot (POST /api/units/:id/contacts) - its requirement_sources map is REMOVEd
// in the same write, so every item is never touched against the new
// landlord. A roster write that keeps the landlord leaves the map alone.
// Asserted on the HTTP response and on the stored unit.
import request from 'supertest';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { TEST_SESSION_COOKIE } from './helpers/authSession.js';
import { REQ_STAMP, seedContact, seedLandlord, seedUnit } from './helpers/requirementsFixtures.js';
import { makeWebhookHarness, ORIGIN_SECRET } from './helpers/twilioWebhookHarness.js';

const sources = (): Record<string, 'copied' | 'set_here'> => ({ pets: 'set_here', credit_requirements: 'copied' });

/** The unitsRestoreLandlord.test.ts shape: SOFT-DELETED, owned by c-old (the primary), c-pm a second row. */
const DELETED = {
  landlordId: 'c-old',
  primary_contact: 'c-old',
  contacts: [
    { contactId: 'c-old', role: 'landlord', primaryContact: true },
    { contactId: 'c-pm', role: 'pm', primaryContact: false },
  ],
  deleted_at: REQ_STAMP,
};

function post(app: import('express').Express, path: string, body?: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const req = request(app).post(path).set('x-origin-verify', ORIGIN_SECRET).set('cookie', TEST_SESSION_COOKIE);
  return body === undefined ? req : req.send(body);
}

describe('POST /api/units/:id/restore - a landlord change REMOVEs requirement_sources (D5)', () => {
  it('a restore onto another landlord REMOVEs the map - response and stored unit', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedUnit(world, 'u-1', { ...DELETED, requirement_sources: sources() });
    seedContact(world, 'c-old', { type: 'tenant' });
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-new');
    const res = await post(app, '/api/units/u-1/restore', { landlordId: 'c-new' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.unit.landlordId).toBe('c-new');
    expect(res.body.unit).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
    expect(world.units.get('u-1')).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
  });

  it('a restore onto NO landlord REMOVEs the map', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedUnit(world, 'u-1', { ...DELETED, requirement_sources: sources() });
    seedContact(world, 'c-old', { type: 'tenant' });
    const res = await post(app, '/api/units/u-1/restore', { landlordId: null });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.unit).not.toHaveProperty('landlordId');
    expect(res.body.unit).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
    expect(world.units.get('u-1')).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
  });

  it('(PIN) a plain restore keeps the landlord and the map', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedUnit(world, 'u-1', { ...DELETED, requirement_sources: sources() });
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-old');
    const res = await post(app, '/api/units/u-1/restore');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual(sources());
  });
});

describe('POST /api/units/:id/contacts - a landlord claim REMOVEs requirement_sources (D5)', () => {
  it('a roster claim of the vacant landlord slot REMOVEs the map - response and stored unit', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedUnit(world, 'u-1', {
      landlordId: undefined,
      contacts: [{ contactId: 'c-pm', role: 'pm', primaryContact: true }],
      primary_contact: 'c-pm',
      requirement_sources: sources(),
    });
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-pm');
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-new');
    const res = await post(app, '/api/units/u-1/contacts', { contactId: 'c-new', role: 'landlord' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.unit.landlordId).toBe('c-new');
    expect(res.body.unit).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
    expect(world.units.get('u-1')).not.toHaveProperty('requirement_sources');
  });

  it('(PIN) adding a row that is not a claim keeps the map', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedUnit(world, 'u-1', {
      contacts: [{ contactId: 'c-ll', role: 'landlord', primaryContact: true }],
      primary_contact: 'c-ll',
      requirement_sources: sources(),
    });
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll');
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-pm');
    const res = await post(app, '/api/units/u-1/contacts', { contactId: 'c-pm', role: 'pm' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual(sources());
  });
});
```

### Task 2.3 - The pure write planner (`app/src/lib/unitRequirementWrite.ts`)

**Goal.** One pure computation of what a unit create or PATCH writes for the
requirement items, so both routes (2.4, 2.5) and every fenced attempt share
it: the legacy `pets` partner (D1), `deposit_conflict` against the stored
record merged with the body (D1), the classification sequence with the reset
on a landlord change (D5, via S1's `nextRequirementSources`), the map written
WHOLE and only when it changes (D5), and the audit field list (D13 as ruled in
PR1-10, CI-3: the keys whose STORED value the write changes, from the read and
the final patch). Also the create-body snapshot split (D5 / plan 2.4).

**Files.**
- `app/src/lib/unitRequirementWrite.ts` (NEW)
- `app/test/unitRequirementWrite.test.ts` (NEW)

**Step 1 - tests (write first).** Create `app/test/unitRequirementWrite.test.ts`:

```ts
// property requirements (spec 2026-10-20 D1, D5, D13): the pure write planner
// behind POST /api/units and PATCH /api/units/:unitId
// (lib/unitRequirementWrite.ts) - the create-body snapshot split, the legacy
// pets partner, deposit_conflict against the stored record, the
// classification (a landlord change resets first), the map written whole and
// only when it changes, and the audit field list.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS, REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS, type RequirementsSnapshot } from '../src/lib/requirements.js';
import {
  applyUnitPatch,
  changedKeys,
  depositConflictAfter,
  planRequirementWrite,
  splitRequirementsSnapshot,
  touchesRequirements,
  type RequirementWritePlan,
} from '../src/lib/unitRequirementWrite.js';

const landlord = (requirements: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> => ({
  contactId: 'c-ll',
  type: 'landlord',
  ...requirements,
});

const ALL_COPIED = Object.fromEntries(REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS.map((id) => [id, 'copied'] as const));

/** A snapshot naming every item with no key set (all blank), then `items` over the top. */
function snapshot(items: RequirementsSnapshot['items'] = {}): RequirementsSnapshot {
  const blank = Object.fromEntries(REQUIREMENT_ITEM_IDS.map((id) => [id, {}] as const)) as RequirementsSnapshot['items'];
  return { landlordId: 'c-ll', items: { ...blank, ...items } };
}

function written(plan: RequirementWritePlan): Extract<RequirementWritePlan, { ok: true }> {
  if (!plan.ok) throw new Error(`expected a write, got ${plan.error}`);
  return plan;
}

describe('touchesRequirements', () => {
  it('is true for every requirement unit key, a REMOVE (null) included', () => {
    for (const key of REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS) expect(touchesRequirements({ [key]: null }), key).toBe(true);
  });

  it('is false for a body without one', () => {
    expect(
      touchesRequirements({ landlordId: 'c-ll', beds: 2, notes: 'x', subzone: 'E8', application_process: 'Online' }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('applyUnitPatch', () => {
  it('SETs values, REMOVEs nulls, skips undefined, and mutates neither input', () => {
    const record = { unitId: 'u-1', pets: 'Cats OK', beds: 2 };
    const patch = { pets: null, no_pets: true, beds: undefined };
    expect(applyUnitPatch(record, patch)).toEqual({ unitId: 'u-1', no_pets: true, beds: 2 });
    expect(record).toEqual({ unitId: 'u-1', pets: 'Cats OK', beds: 2 });
    expect(patch).toEqual({ pets: null, no_pets: true, beds: undefined });
  });
});

describe('changedKeys (D13, plan review PR1-10)', () => {
  it('lists a SET to a new value and a SET of a key the read lacked; not a key re-sent with its stored value', () => {
    expect(
      changedKeys(
        { beds: 2, income_requirements: '2x rent', address: { line1: '1 Main' } },
        { beds: 2, income_requirements: '3x rent', address: { line1: '1 Main' }, pet_fee: '$50' },
      ),
    ).toEqual(['income_requirements', 'pet_fee']);
  });

  it('lists a REMOVE of a key the read held; not a REMOVE of a key it lacked', () => {
    expect(changedKeys({ deposit: 1200 }, { deposit: null, no_pets: null })).toEqual(['deposit']);
  });

  it('never lists requirement_sources, and skips undefined', () => {
    expect(changedKeys({}, { requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied' }, beds: undefined, no_pets: true })).toEqual([
      'no_pets',
    ]);
  });
});

describe('depositConflictAfter (D1)', () => {
  it('a one-month deposit over a STORED fixed amount conflicts', () => {
    expect(depositConflictAfter({ deposit: 1200 }, { deposit_one_month: true })).toBe(true);
  });

  it('sending the amount as null in the same write does not', () => {
    expect(depositConflictAfter({ deposit: 1200 }, { deposit_one_month: true, deposit: null })).toBe(false);
  });

  it('a body carrying no Deposit key is never checked', () => {
    expect(depositConflictAfter({ deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 5 }, { beds: 2 })).toBe(false);
  });

  it('on create (no stored record) the body alone decides', () => {
    expect(depositConflictAfter(undefined, { deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 1200 })).toBe(true);
    expect(depositConflictAfter(undefined, { deposit_flexible: true, deposit: 1200 })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('splitRequirementsSnapshot (D5 create)', () => {
  it('passes a body without the key through untouched', () => {
    const body = { landlordId: 'c-ll', beds: 2 };
    const split = splitRequirementsSnapshot(body);
    expect(split).toEqual({ ok: true, body });
    if (split.ok) {
      expect(split.body).toBe(body);
      expect(split.snapshot).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it('takes the snapshot OFF the body and parses it', () => {
    const split = splitRequirementsSnapshot({
      landlordId: 'c-ll',
      beds: 2,
      requirements_snapshot: { landlordId: 'c-ll', pets: { no_pets: true } },
    });
    expect(split.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!split.ok) return;
    expect(split.body).toEqual({ landlordId: 'c-ll', beds: 2 });
    expect(split.snapshot?.landlordId).toBe('c-ll');
    expect(split.snapshot?.items.pets?.['no_pets']).toBe(true);
  });

  it('answers the parse error for a malformed snapshot', () => {
    expect(splitRequirementsSnapshot({ landlordId: 'c-ll', requirements_snapshot: 'x' })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      error: 'requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId',
    });
  });

  it('passes a body that is not an object through, for the validator to refuse', () => {
    expect(splitRequirementsSnapshot('nope')).toEqual({ ok: true, body: 'nope' });
  });
});

describe('planRequirementWrite - create (D5)', () => {
  it('without a snapshot: only the items written non-blank are classified, against the landlord', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: undefined,
        fields: { landlordId: 'c-ll', no_pets: true, income_requirements: '3x rent' },
        landlord: landlord({ req_no_pets: true, req_credit_requirements: 'Score 600+' }),
        landlordChanged: false,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch['requirement_sources']).toEqual({ pets: 'copied', income_requirements: 'set_here' });
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual(['landlordId', 'no_pets', 'income_requirements']);
  });

  it('without a snapshot and no requirement field: no requirement_sources key at all', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({ stored: undefined, fields: { landlordId: 'c-ll', beds: 2 }, landlord: landlord(), landlordChanged: false }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch).toEqual({ landlordId: 'c-ll', beds: 2 });
  });

  it('an all-blank snapshot, a blank landlord and a blank form: all eight copied', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: undefined,
        fields: { landlordId: 'c-ll' },
        landlord: landlord(),
        landlordChanged: false,
        snapshot: snapshot(),
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch['requirement_sources']).toEqual(ALL_COPIED);
  });

  it('with a snapshot: a field left as pre-filled is copied even when the landlord changed since', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: undefined,
        fields: { landlordId: 'c-ll', no_pets: true, pet_fee: '$300' },
        landlord: landlord({ req_no_pets: true, req_pet_fee: '$350' }),
        landlordChanged: false,
        snapshot: snapshot({ pets: { no_pets: true, pet_fee: '$300' } }),
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch['requirement_sources']).toEqual(ALL_COPIED);
  });

  it('deposit_conflict: a new record holding a one-month deposit and a fixed amount', () => {
    expect(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: undefined,
        fields: { landlordId: 'c-ll', deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 1200 },
        landlord: landlord(),
        landlordChanged: false,
      }),
    ).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'deposit_conflict' });
  });
});

describe('planRequirementWrite - PATCH (D5, D1, D13)', () => {
  it('a classified item overwrites its entry; untouched entries are kept; the map is never an audit field', () => {
    const stored = {
      unitId: 'u-1',
      landlordId: 'c-ll',
      credit_requirements: 'Score 650',
      requirement_sources: { credit_requirements: 'set_here' },
    };
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored,
        fields: { income_requirements: '3x rent' },
        landlord: landlord({ req_income_requirements: '3x rent' }),
        landlordChanged: false,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch).toEqual({
      income_requirements: '3x rent',
      requirement_sources: { credit_requirements: 'set_here', income_requirements: 'copied' },
    });
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual(['income_requirements']);
    expect(stored.requirement_sources).toEqual({ credit_requirements: 'set_here' });
  });

  it('a write that changes no interpreted value leaves the map out of the patch', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: { unitId: 'u-1', landlordId: 'c-ll', income_requirements: '3x rent', requirement_sources: { income_requirements: 'copied' } },
        fields: { income_requirements: '3x rent' },
        landlord: landlord({ req_income_requirements: '2x rent' }),
        landlordChanged: false,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch).toEqual({ income_requirements: '3x rent' });
    expect(plan.sources).toEqual({ income_requirements: 'copied' });
    // D13 (PR1-10): a key re-sent with its stored value is not an audit field.
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('audit fields: a re-sent unchanged key is left out, the changed one listed', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: { unitId: 'u-1', landlordId: 'c-ll', beds: 2, income_requirements: '2x rent' },
        fields: { beds: 2, income_requirements: '3x rent' },
        landlord: landlord({ req_income_requirements: '3x rent' }),
        landlordChanged: false,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual(['income_requirements']);
  });

  it('audit fields: clearing an amount the unit never held is not listed', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: { unitId: 'u-1', landlordId: 'c-ll' },
        fields: { deposit_one_month: true, deposit: null },
        landlord: landlord(),
        landlordChanged: false,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual(['deposit_one_month']);
  });

  it('a landlord change with no item REMOVEs the map', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: { unitId: 'u-1', landlordId: 'c-ll', pets: 'Cats OK', requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } },
        fields: { landlordId: 'c-2' },
        landlord: { contactId: 'c-2', type: 'landlord' },
        landlordChanged: true,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch).toEqual({ landlordId: 'c-2', requirement_sources: null });
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual(['landlordId']);
  });

  it('a landlord change on a unit with no map and no item writes no map key', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: { unitId: 'u-1', landlordId: 'c-ll' },
        fields: { landlordId: 'c-2' },
        landlord: { contactId: 'c-2', type: 'landlord' },
        landlordChanged: true,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch).toEqual({ landlordId: 'c-2' });
  });

  it('a landlord change AND a touched item: reset first, then classified against the NEW landlord', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: { unitId: 'u-1', landlordId: 'c-ll', pets: 'Cats OK', requirement_sources: { pets: 'set_here' } },
        fields: { landlordId: 'c-2', income_requirements: '3x rent' },
        landlord: { contactId: 'c-2', type: 'landlord', req_income_requirements: '3x rent' },
        landlordChanged: true,
      }),
    );
    expect(plan.patch['requirement_sources']).toEqual({ income_requirements: 'copied' });
  });

  it('legacy pets:false met by a pet_fee write: No pets and blank details are written in the new shape', () => {
    const plan = written(
      planRequirementWrite({
        stored: { unitId: 'u-1', landlordId: 'c-ll', pets: false },
        fields: { pet_fee: '$300' },
        landlord: landlord({ req_no_pets: true, req_pet_fee: '$300' }),
        landlordChanged: false,

    expect(plan.patch).toEqual({ pet_fee: '$300', no_pets: true, pets: null, requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied' } });
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual(['pet_fee', 'no_pets', 'pets']);
  });

  it('legacy pets:true met by a pet_fee write: the details read Allowed; an absent no_pets is not listed', () => {
    const plan = written(

        fields: { pet_fee: '$50' },

    expect(plan.patch).toEqual({ pet_fee: '$50', pets: 'Allowed', requirement_sources: { pets: 'copied' } });
    expect(plan.auditFields).toEqual(['pet_fee', 'pets']);

  it('legacy pets:true met by a no_pets write keeps the details as they read', () => {
    const plan = written(

  it('deposit_conflict against the stored record', () => {
```

**Step 3 - implementation.** Create `app/src/lib/unitRequirementWrite.ts`:

```ts
// property requirements (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-property-requirements-design.md
// D1, D5, D13; plan 2.4): what ONE unit create or PATCH writes for the
// requirement items, computed purely from the stored unit (a CONSISTENT read;
// none on create), the validated body and the landlord of record's contact.
// The units router (routes/units.ts) is the only caller: POST /api/units once,
// PATCH /api/units/:unitId once per fenced attempt (each attempt recomputes
// from its own read). The rules live in lib/requirements.ts; this module only
// sequences them:
//   1. deposit_conflict (D1): the stored record merged with the body holds a
//      one-month deposit and a fixed amount, whenever the body carries a
//      Deposit key;
//   2. the legacy `pets` partner (D1): a STORED boolean `pets` met by a write
//      touching some Pets keys also writes `no_pets` / `pets` in the new shape
//      with their interpreted values, so nothing else in the item changes;
//   3. the classification (D5, nextRequirementSources): after a landlord
//      change the map starts EMPTY - every item never touched against the new
//      landlord - before this write's own items are classified;
//   4. the audit field list (D13; plan review PR1-10): the unit keys whose
//      STORED value the write changes - a SET to a value different from the
//      read (or of a key the read lacked), or a REMOVE of a key the read held
//      - partner keys included, never requirement_sources. A body key re-sent
//      with its stored value is not listed. (The route uses it on the fenced
//      path only; the plain path keeps Object.keys(validation.fields).)
// The map is written WHOLE and only when it changes (an empty map REMOVEs);
// on create it rides in the Put when non-empty.
import { isDeepStrictEqual } from 'node:util';
import {
  hasDepositConflict,
  nextRequirementSources,
  parseRequirementsSnapshot,
  readRequirementSources,
  REQUIREMENT_ITEMS,
  REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS,
  type RequirementItemId,
  type RequirementSources,
  type RequirementsSnapshot,
} from './requirements.js';

const REQUIREMENT_KEY_SET: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS);

function hasKey(record: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): boolean {
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record, key);
}

function keysOfItem(id: RequirementItemId): string[] {
  return REQUIREMENT_ITEMS.find((item) => item.id === id)?.fields.map((field) => field.key) ?? [];
}

function writesItem(fields: Record<string, unknown>, id: RequirementItemId): boolean {
  return keysOfItem(id).some((key) => hasKey(fields, key));
}

/** D5: the validated body writes at least one requirement key (the PATCH read path). */
export function touchesRequirements(fields: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  return Object.keys(fields).some((key) => REQUIREMENT_KEY_SET.has(key));
}

/** `record` with `patch` applied the way the repos apply one: null REMOVEs, undefined is skipped. Mutates neither. */
export function applyUnitPatch(
  record: Record<string, unknown>,
  patch: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...record };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    if (value === null) delete next[key];
    else next[key] = value;
  }
  return next;
}

/** D1: the body carries a Deposit key and the record it leaves holds both a one-month deposit and a fixed amount. `stored` undefined = create. */
export function depositConflictAfter(
  stored: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  fields: Record<string, unknown>,
): boolean {
  if (!writesItem(fields, 'deposit')) return false;
  return hasDepositConflict(applyUnitPatch(stored ?? {}, fields), 'unit');
}

/**
 * D5 / plan 2.4: take `requirements_snapshot` OFF a create body before the
 * field allowlist sees it (it is never stored) and parse it. A body without
 * the key, or one that is not an object, passes through untouched (the
 * validator answers the latter).
 */
export function splitRequirementsSnapshot(
  body: unknown,
): { ok: true; body: unknown; snapshot?: RequirementsSnapshot } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  if (typeof body !== 'object' || body === null || Array.isArray(body)) return { ok: true, body };
  if (!hasKey(body as Record<string, unknown>, 'requirements_snapshot')) return { ok: true, body };
  const { requirements_snapshot: raw, ...rest } = body as Record<string, unknown>;
  const parsed = parseRequirementsSnapshot(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) return { ok: false, error: parsed.error };
  return { ok: true, body: rest, snapshot: parsed.snapshot };
}

/**
 * D1: the partner keys a write must add when the STORED `pets` is a legacy
 * boolean and the body touches the Pets item - `false` reads as No pets
 * checked with blank details, `true` as No pets unchecked with details
 * "Allowed". Only keys the body leaves out, and only those whose stored value
 * this changes.
 */
function legacyPetsPartner(
  stored: Record<string, unknown>,
  fields: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const storedPets = stored['pets'];
  if (typeof storedPets !== 'boolean' || !writesItem(fields, 'pets')) return {};
  const partner: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (!hasKey(fields, 'no_pets')) {
    if (storedPets === false && stored['no_pets'] !== true) partner['no_pets'] = true;
    if (storedPets === true && hasKey(stored, 'no_pets')) partner['no_pets'] = null;
  }
  if (!hasKey(fields, 'pets')) partner['pets'] = storedPets ? 'Allowed' : null;
  return partner;
}

function sameSources(a: RequirementSources, b: RequirementSources): boolean {
  const ids = Object.keys(a) as RequirementItemId[];
  return ids.length === Object.keys(b).length && ids.every((id) => a[id] === b[id]);
}

/**
 * D13 (plan review PR1-10): the keys of `patch` whose STORED value the write
 * changes - a SET to a value different from `before` (or of a key `before`
 * lacks), or a REMOVE (null) of a key `before` holds. Patch order;
 * requirement_sources never listed.
 */
export function changedKeys(before: Record<string, unknown>, patch: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
  return Object.entries(patch)
    .filter(([key, value]) => {
      if (key === 'requirement_sources' || value === undefined) return false;
      if (value === null) return hasKey(before, key);
      return !hasKey(before, key) || !isDeepStrictEqual(before[key], value);
    })
    .map(([key]) => key);
}

export interface RequirementWriteInput {
  /** The consistent read of the stored unit (the caller's copy); undefined on create. */
  stored: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  /** validateUnitBody's fields (null = REMOVE). */
  fields: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** The landlord of record's contact AFTER this write (the new one on a change); undefined = none. */
  landlord: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  /** PATCH only: this write changes the landlord of record, so the map is reset first (D5). */
  landlordChanged: boolean;
  /** D5: the New form's snapshot (create only). */
  snapshot?: RequirementsSnapshot;
}

export type RequirementWritePlan =
  | {
      ok: true;
      /** What the repo writes: the body, the partner keys, and requirement_sources (map, or null = REMOVE) when it changes. */
      patch: Record<string, unknown>;
      /** D13 (PR1-10): the unit keys whose stored value this write changes (changedKeys), body order then partner order; never requirement_sources. */
      auditFields: string[];
      /** The whole map after this write (what the property will hold). */
      sources: RequirementSources;
    }
  | { ok: false; error: 'deposit_conflict' };

export function planRequirementWrite(input: RequirementWriteInput): RequirementWritePlan {
  const before = input.stored ?? {};
  if (depositConflictAfter(input.stored, input.fields)) return { ok: false, error: 'deposit_conflict' };
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = { ...input.fields, ...legacyPetsPartner(before, input.fields) };
  const auditFields = changedKeys(before, patch);
  const after = applyUnitPatch(before, patch);
  const held = readRequirementSources(before['requirement_sources']);
  const sources = nextRequirementSources({
    before,
    after,
    current: input.landlordChanged ? {} : held,
    landlord: input.landlord,
    ...(input.snapshot !== undefined && { snapshot: input.snapshot }),
  });
  const nonEmpty = Object.keys(sources).length > 0;
  if (input.stored === undefined) {
    if (nonEmpty) patch['requirement_sources'] = sources;
  } else if (input.landlordChanged) {
    if (nonEmpty || hasKey(before, 'requirement_sources')) {
      patch['requirement_sources'] = nonEmpty ? sources : null;
    }
  } else if (!sameSources(sources, held)) {
    patch['requirement_sources'] = nonEmpty ? sources : null;
  }
  return { ok: true, patch, auditFields, sources };
}
```

### Task 2.4 - POST /api/units: snapshot, classification, deposit_conflict

**Goal.** D5 create: the body MAY carry `requirements_snapshot`; the route
takes it off before the validator (never stored), answers the plan 2.4 400s
(malformed; `requirements_snapshot.landlordId does not match landlordId`),
answers 400 `deposit_conflict` (D1), and stores `requirement_sources` from
the planner - against the snapshot for every item it names, else against the
landlord just read (only items written non-blank). The landlord read is the
existing `requireLandlordContact` (no second read). Response carries the map.

```ts
// property requirements (spec 2026-10-20 D5, D1; plan 2.4): POST /api/units
// records where each requirement value came from. With the New form's
// requirements_snapshot every item it names is classified against the
// SNAPSHOT (left as pre-filled -> copied; changed or cleared -> set_here),
// whatever the landlord holds now; without one only the items the body writes
// are classified, against the landlord's CURRENT values. The snapshot is never
// stored; a malformed one, or one taken from another landlord, is a 400, and
// so is a property holding both a one-month deposit and a fixed amount - all
// before the landlord check. requirement_sources is asserted on the HTTP
// response.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { ALL_COPIED, getUnit, postUnit, seedLandlord, snapshotOf } from './helpers/requirementsFixtures.js';
import { makeWebhookHarness } from './helpers/twilioWebhookHarness.js';

describe('POST /api/units - with the New form requirements_snapshot (D5)', () => {
  it('fields left as pre-filled are copied, a cleared and a changed item are set here, and the snapshot is never stored', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll', {
      req_no_pets: true,
      req_pet_fee: '$300',
      req_credit_requirements: 'Score 600+',
      req_tour_type: 'landlord_led',
      req_tour_process: 'Call Lee first',
    });
    const res = await postUnit(app, {
      landlordId: 'c-ll',
      requirements_snapshot: snapshotOf('c-ll', {
        pets: { no_pets: true, pet_fee: '$300' },
        credit_requirements: { credit_requirements: 'Score 600+' },
        touring: { tour_type: 'landlord_led', tour_process: 'Call Lee first' },
      }),
      no_pets: true,
      pet_fee: '$300',
      tour_type: 'landlord_led',
      tour_process: 'Text Lee first',
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual({
      ...ALL_COPIED,
      credit_requirements: 'set_here',
      touring: 'set_here',
    });
    expect(res.body.unit).not.toHaveProperty('requirements_snapshot');
    expect(res.body.unit).not.toHaveProperty('credit_requirements');
    const unitId = res.body.unit.unitId as string;
    const stored = world.units.get(unitId);
    expect(stored?.requirement_sources).toEqual(res.body.unit.requirement_sources);
    expect(stored).not.toHaveProperty('requirements_snapshot');
    const got = await getUnit(app, unitId);
    expect(got.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual(res.body.unit.requirement_sources);
  });

  it('every field left as pre-filled: all eight copied, even when the landlord changed after the form filled in', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll', { req_no_pets: true, req_pet_fee: '$350' });
    const res = await postUnit(app, {
      landlordId: 'c-ll',
      requirements_snapshot: snapshotOf('c-ll', { pets: { no_pets: true, pet_fee: '$300' } }),
      no_pets: true,
      pet_fee: '$300',
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual(ALL_COPIED);
    expect(res.body.unit.pet_fee).toBe('$300');
  });

  it('an all-blank snapshot (a landlord with no requirements) and a blank form: all eight copied', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll');
    const res = await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ll', requirements_snapshot: snapshotOf('c-ll') });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual(ALL_COPIED);
  });

  it('an item the snapshot does not name is classified as without one; an unknown snapshot item is ignored', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll', { req_no_pets: true });
    const res = await postUnit(app, {
      landlordId: 'c-ll',
      requirements_snapshot: { landlordId: 'c-ll', pets: { no_pets: true }, frobnicate: { x: 1 } },
      no_pets: true,
      income_requirements: '3x rent',
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual({ pets: 'copied', income_requirements: 'set_here' });
  });

  const MALFORMED: Array<[string, unknown, string]> = [
    ['a string', 'x', 'requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId'],
    ['null', null, 'requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId'],
    ['no landlordId', { pets: { no_pets: true } }, 'requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId'],
    ['an item that is not an object', { landlordId: 'c-ll', pets: 'No pets' }, 'requirements_snapshot.pets must be an object'],
  ];

  it.each(MALFORMED)('a malformed snapshot (%s) is a 400 - nothing created, no audit row', async (_name, raw, error) => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll');
    const res = await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ll', requirements_snapshot: raw });
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ error });
    expect(world.units.size).toBe(0);
    expect(world.auditEvents).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('a snapshot taken from another landlord is a 400 - nothing created', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll');
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll-2');
    const res = await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ll', requirements_snapshot: snapshotOf('c-ll-2') });
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ error: 'requirements_snapshot.landlordId does not match landlordId' });
    expect(world.units.size).toBe(0);
  });

  it('the snapshot 400 comes before the landlord check (an unknown landlord still answers the 400)', async () => {
    const { app } = makeWebhookHarness();
    const res = await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ghost', requirements_snapshot: 'x' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ error: 'requirements_snapshot must be an object with a landlordId' });
  });
});

describe('POST /api/units - without a snapshot (D5)', () => {
  it("only the items the body writes are classified, against the landlord's CURRENT values", async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll', { req_no_pets: true, req_credit_requirements: 'Score 600+' });
    const res = await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ll', no_pets: true, income_requirements: '3x rent' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.unit.requirement_sources).toEqual({ pets: 'copied', income_requirements: 'set_here' });
  });

  it('(PIN) a create writing no requirement field carries no requirement_sources', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll', { req_no_pets: true });

});

describe('POST /api/units - deposit_conflict (D1)', () => {
  it('a one-month deposit with a fixed amount is a 400 - nothing created, no audit row', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll');
    const res = await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ll', deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 1200 });

    const { app } = makeWebhookHarness();
    const res = await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ghost', deposit_one_month: true, deposit: 1200 });
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ error: 'deposit_conflict' });
  });

  it('(PIN) a one-month deposit alone, and a fixed amount alone, both create', async () => {
    const { app, world } = makeWebhookHarness();
    seedLandlord(world, 'c-ll');
    expect((await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ll', deposit_one_month: true })).status).toBe(201);
    expect((await postUnit(app, { landlordId: 'c-ll', deposit: 1200 })).status).toBe(201);
  });
});
```

```ts
  router.post('/', async (req: AuthedRequest, res) => {
    // property requirements (spec 2026-10-20 D5; plan 2.4): the New form's
    // `requirements_snapshot` - the landlord's values it filled in - comes OFF
    // the body before the field allowlist sees it and is never stored. A
    // malformed snapshot is a 400 ahead of the validator's.

      return;
    }
    const validation = validateUnitBody(split.body, 'create');
    if (!validation.ok) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: validation.error });
      return;
    }
    // D5: the snapshot must have been taken from the landlord this property is
    // created for.
    if (split.snapshot !== undefined && split.snapshot.landlordId !== validation.fields['landlordId']) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'requirements_snapshot.landlordId does not match landlordId' });
      return;
    }
    // D1: "One month's rent" and a fixed amount are alternatives - a new
    // property holding both is a 400, with the other 400s.
    if (depositConflictAfter(undefined, validation.fields)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'deposit_conflict' });
      return;
    }
```
